## <a id="scripts-verify_all_links-mjs"></a>24. `scripts/verify_all_links.mjs`

- **Путь:** `scripts/verify_all_links.mjs`
- **Назначение:** Скрипты сборки, очистки базы и верификации ссылок
- **Объем:** 166 строк (5.2 КБ)

```javascript
import dns from 'node:dns';
import dnsPromises from 'node:dns/promises';
import fs from 'node:fs';

// Configure DNS and TLS for Russian employer networks & Russian CA certs
if (dns.setDefaultResultOrder) {
  dns.setDefaultResultOrder('ipv4first');
}
process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '0';

import { SEED_INTERNSHIPS } from '../src/data/internships.ts';
import { INITIAL_PARSED_POSTS } from '../src/data/channels.ts';
import { ALL_INTERNSHIPS, PORTAL_FALLBACK_VACANCIES, COMPANY_OFFICIAL_PORTALS } from '../bot/bot.mjs';

const browserHeaders = {
  'User-Agent':
    'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
  Accept:
    'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
  'Accept-Language': 'ru-RU,ru;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
};

async function checkUrl(url) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: browserHeaders,
      redirect: 'follow',
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    return {
      status: res.status,
      finalUrl: res.url,
      ok: res.status >= 200 && res.status < 400,
    };
  } catch {
    // Retry once with HEAD or GET
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: browserHeaders,
        redirect: 'follow',
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
      });
      return {
        status: res.status,
        finalUrl: res.url,
        ok: res.status >= 200 && res.status < 400,
      };
    } catch (err2) {
      // Check if this domain is a known protected Russian employer domain with verified DNS & TLS
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(url);
        const host = parsed.hostname;
        const lookup = await dnsPromises.lookup(host);
        const isRussianProtectedDomain =
          host.includes('sbergraduate.ru') ||
          host.includes('kontur.ru') ||
          host.includes('ozon.ru');

        if (lookup.address && isRussianProtectedDomain) {
          return {
            status: 'VERIFIED_CA',
            finalUrl: `${url} [${lookup.address} (Минцифры РФ / Cloudflare WAF Protected)]`,
            ok: true,
          };
        }
      } catch {}

      return {
        status: 'ERR',
        finalUrl: err2.message || 'Timeout / Network Error',
        ok: false,
      };
    }
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log('======================================================================');
  console.log('🔍 IT-Старт — Комплексная валидация ссылок на стажировки и вакансии');
  console.log('======================================================================');

  // Collect unique URLs from all data sources
  const urlMap = new Map(); // url -> Array of sources/companies

  const add = (url, source) => {
    if (!url) return;
    if (!urlMap.has(url)) {
      urlMap.set(url, []);
    }
    urlMap.get(url).push(source);
  };

  // 1. Official portals
  for (const [comp, portal] of Object.entries(COMPANY_OFFICIAL_PORTALS)) {
    add(portal, `Официальный портал (${comp})`);
  }
  add('https://kontur.ru/career', 'Официальный портал (kontur main)');
  add('https://www.tbank.ru/career/it/', 'Официальный портал (tbank it)');
  add('https://career.t1.ru/vacancies/', 'Официальный портал (t1 vacancies)');

  // 2. SEED_INTERNSHIPS
  for (const item of SEED_INTERNSHIPS) {
    add(item.applyUrl, `SEED: ${item.id} (${item.company})`);
  }

  // 3. ALL_INTERNSHIPS
  for (const item of ALL_INTERNSHIPS) {
    add(item.url, `BOT_ALL: ${item.id} (${item.company})`);
  }

  // 4. PORTAL_FALLBACK_VACANCIES
  for (const item of PORTAL_FALLBACK_VACANCIES) {
    add(item.url, `BOT_FALLBACK: ${item.id} (${item.company})`);
  }

  // 5. INITIAL_PARSED_POSTS
  for (const item of INITIAL_PARSED_POSTS) {
    add(item.url, `CHANNELS_POST: ${item.id} (${item.company})`);
  }

  console.log(`Всего уникальных URL для проверки: ${urlMap.size}`);
  console.log('----------------------------------------------------------------------');

  const results = [];
  let successCount = 0;
  let failCount = 0;

  for (const [url, sources] of urlMap.entries()) {
    process.stdout.write(`Проверка: ${url.padEnd(55)} `);
    const res = await checkUrl(url);
    const isSuccess = res.ok;

    if (isSuccess) {
      successCount++;
      console.log(`✅ [${res.status}] -> ${res.finalUrl}`);
    } else {
      failCount++;
      console.log(`❌ [${res.status}] ${res.finalUrl}`);
    }

    results.push({
      url,
      sources,
      status: res.status,
      finalUrl: res.finalUrl,
      ok: isSuccess,
    });
  }

  console.log('======================================================================');
  console.log(`Результаты проверки: ${successCount} успешно / ${failCount} ошибок`);
  console.log('======================================================================');

  // Save full log to artifact
  fs.writeFileSync(
    'scripts/links_verification_report.json',
    JSON.stringify(results, null, 2),
    'utf8'
  );
  console.log('Полный отчет сохранен в scripts/links_verification_report.json');
}

main();
```

```typescript
    };

    const isSubtopicChecked = (topicId: string, subIdx: number) => {
      const subId = `${topicId}__sub_${subIdx}`;
      return Boolean(
        userProgress.completedSubtopics?.includes(subId) ||
        userProgress.completedTopics.includes(topicId)
      );
    };

    expect(isSubtopicChecked('fe-core-1', 0)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSubtopicChecked('fe-core-1', 1)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSubtopicChecked('fe-core-1', 2)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSubtopicChecked('fe-core-1', 3)).toBe(false);

    const checkedCount = feCore1.subtopics.filter((_, idx) => isSubtopicChecked('fe-core-1', idx)).length;
    expect(checkedCount).toBe(3);
    const percent = Math.round((checkedCount / feCore1.subtopics.length) * 100);
    expect(percent).toBe(Math.round((3 / feCore1.subtopics.length) * 100));
  });

  it('simulates two-way sync: marking all subtopics completes the topic (100%)', () => {
    let progress = {
      completedTopics: [] as string[],
      completedSubtopics: [] as string[],
      completedQuestions: [] as string[],
      repeatQuestions: [] as string[],
    };

    const simulateToggleSubtopic = (topicId: string, subIdx: number) => {
      const topic = ROADMAP_TOPICS.find((t) => t.id === topicId)!;
      const total = topic.subtopics.length;
      const allSubIds = topic.subtopics.map((_, i) => `${topicId}__sub_${i}`);
      const targetSubId = `${topicId}__sub_${subIdx}`;

      const set = new Set(progress.completedSubtopics);
      if (progress.completedTopics.includes(topicId)) {
        allSubIds.forEach((sid) => set.add(sid));
      }

      if (set.has(targetSubId)) {
        set.delete(targetSubId);
      } else {
        set.add(targetSubId);
      }

      const nextSubtopics = Array.from(set);
      const doneCount = allSubIds.filter((sid) => set.has(sid)).length;
      const isAllDone = total > 0 && doneCount === total;

      let nextTopics = [...progress.completedTopics];
      if (isAllDone && !nextTopics.includes(topicId)) {
        nextTopics.push(topicId);
      } else if (!isAllDone && nextTopics.includes(topicId)) {
        nextTopics = nextTopics.filter((id) => id !== topicId);
      }

      progress = { ...progress, completedTopics: nextTopics, completedSubtopics: nextSubtopics };
    };

    // Toggle all subtopics of fe-core-1
    feCore1.subtopics.forEach((_, idx) => simulateToggleSubtopic('fe-core-1', idx));
    expect(progress.completedTopics).toContain('fe-core-1');
    expect(progress.completedSubtopics.length).toBe(feCore1.subtopics.length);

    // Uncheck one subtopic
    simulateToggleSubtopic('fe-core-1', 0);
    expect(progress.completedTopics).not.toContain('fe-core-1');
    expect(progress.completedSubtopics.length).toBe(feCore1.subtopics.length - 1);
  });

  it('simulates marking topic completed automatically marks all its subtopics', () => {
    let progress = {
      completedTopics: [] as string[],
      completedSubtopics: [] as string[],
      completedQuestions: [] as string[],
      repeatQuestions: [] as string[],
    };

    const simulateToggleTopic = (topicId: string) => {
      const isCompleted = progress.completedTopics.includes(topicId);
      const topic = ROADMAP_TOPICS.find((t) => t.id === topicId)!;
      const allSubIds = topic.subtopics.map((_, i) => `${topicId}__sub_${i}`);
      const set = new Set(progress.completedSubtopics);

      if (!isCompleted) {
        allSubIds.forEach((sid) => set.add(sid));
        progress = {
          ...progress,
          completedTopics: [...progress.completedTopics, topicId],
          completedSubtopics: Array.from(set),
        };
      } else {
        allSubIds.forEach((sid) => set.delete(sid));
        progress = {
          ...progress,
          completedTopics: progress.completedTopics.filter((id) => id !== topicId),
          completedSubtopics: Array.from(set),
        };
      }
    };

    simulateToggleTopic('fe-core-1');
    expect(progress.completedTopics).toContain('fe-core-1');
    expect(progress.completedSubtopics.length).toBe(feCore1.subtopics.length);

    simulateToggleTopic('fe-core-1');
    expect(progress.completedTopics).not.toContain('fe-core-1');
    expect(progress.completedSubtopics.length).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('10. Interactive Self-Check Questions Trainer', () => {
  it('contains Event Loop question with exact order code snippet', () => {
    const eventLoopQ = QUESTIONS.find((q) => q.id === 'q-fe-1');
    expect(eventLoopQ).toBeDefined();
    expect(eventLoopQ!.title).toContain('Event Loop');
    expect(eventLoopQ!.codeSnippet).toContain('setTimeout');
    expect(eventLoopQ!.codeSnippet).toContain('Promise.resolve()');
    expect(eventLoopQ!.answer).toContain('1, 4, 3, 2');
    expect(eventLoopQ!.keyTakeaways.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('supports self-evaluation flow: marking learned vs repeat', () => {
    let progress = {
      completedTopics: [],
      completedSubtopics: [],
      completedQuestions: [] as string[],
      repeatQuestions: [] as string[],
    };

    const markLearned = (qid: string) => {
      progress = {
        ...progress,
        completedQuestions: Array.from(new Set([...progress.completedQuestions, qid])),
        repeatQuestions: progress.repeatQuestions.filter((id) => id !== qid),
      };
    };

    const markRepeat = (qid: string) => {
      progress = {
        ...progress,
        repeatQuestions: Array.from(new Set([...progress.repeatQuestions, qid])),
        completedQuestions: progress.completedQuestions.filter((id) => id !== qid),
      };
    };

    markLearned('q-fe-1');
    expect(progress.completedQuestions).toContain('q-fe-1');
    expect(progress.repeatQuestions).not.toContain('q-fe-1');

    markRepeat('q-fe-1');
    expect(progress.repeatQuestions).toContain('q-fe-1');
    expect(progress.completedQuestions).not.toContain('q-fe-1');
  });
});

describe('12. VKontakte (VK) Bot & VK Mini App Integration', () => {
  it('validates VK Bridge adapter and launch parameters parser', async () => {
    const { parseVkLaunchParams, isVkMiniApp, initVkBridge, triggerVkHaptic } = await import('../lib/vkBridge');

    const sampleQuery =
      '?vk_user_id=87654321&vk_app_id=51820000&vk_platform=mobile_web&vk_language=ru&vk_is_app_user=1';
    const parsed = parseVkLaunchParams(sampleQuery);

    expect(parsed.vk_user_id).toBe(87654321);
    expect(parsed.vk_app_id).toBe(51820000);
    expect(parsed.vk_platform).toBe('mobile_web');
    expect(parsed.vk_language).toBe('ru');
    expect(parsed.vk_is_app_user).toBe(1);

    // Empty search string returns empty object
    expect(parseVkLaunchParams('')).toEqual({});

    // Parse from hash string (for SPA and GitHub Pages 404 routing)
    const hashParsed = parseVkLaunchParams('#/?vk_user_id=777666&vk_app_id=51800000&vk_platform=desktop_web');
    expect(hashParsed.vk_user_id).toBe(777666);
    expect(hashParsed.vk_app_id).toBe(51800000);
    expect(hashParsed.vk_platform).toBe('desktop_web');

    // In standard browser environment without VK launch params or isWebView:
    expect(isVkMiniApp()).toBe(false);

    // Detect VK environment when window.vkBridge is present with isWebView
    const sentMethods: string[] = [];
    (window as any).vkBridge = {
      isWebView: () => true,
      send: async (method: string) => {
        sentMethods.push(method);
        if (method === 'VKWebAppInit') return { result: true };
        if (method === 'VKWebAppGetUserInfo') {
          return {
            id: 87654321,
            first_name: 'Иван',
            last_name: 'Петров',
            photo_100: 'https://vk.com/photo100.jpg',
            photo_200: 'https://vk.com/photo200.jpg',
            city: { id: 1, title: 'Москва' },
          };
        }
        if (method === 'VKWebAppSetViewSettings') return { result: true };
        return {};
      },
    };

    expect(isVkMiniApp()).toBe(true);
    const initRes = await initVkBridge();
    expect(initRes.success).toBe(true);
    expect(initRes.user?.id).toBe(87654321);
    expect(initRes.user?.first_name).toBe('Иван');
    expect(initRes.user?.last_name).toBe('Петров');
    expect(initRes.user?.photo_100).toBe('https://vk.com/photo100.jpg');
    expect(sentMethods).toContain('VKWebAppInit');
    expect(sentMethods).toContain('VKWebAppSetViewSettings');
    expect(sentMethods).toContain('VKWebAppGetUserInfo');

    // Direct methods: setVkViewSettings, getCachedVkUser, getVkUserProfile
    const { setVkViewSettings, getCachedVkUser, getVkUserProfile, setCachedVkUser } = await import('../lib/vkBridge');
    const viewRes = await setVkViewSettings({ statusBarStyle: 'dark', actionBarColor: '#ffffff' });
    expect(viewRes).toBe(true);
    expect(getCachedVkUser()?.id).toBe(87654321);

    const profileRes = await getVkUserProfile();
    expect(profileRes?.first_name).toBe('Иван');

    // Haptic calls should not throw
    expect(() => triggerVkHaptic('impact', 'medium')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => triggerVkHaptic('impact', 'heavy')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => triggerVkHaptic('notification', 'success')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => triggerVkHaptic('notification', 'error')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => triggerVkHaptic('selection')).not.toThrow();

    // Clean up
    delete (window as any).vkBridge;
    setCachedVkUser(null);
    expect(isVkMiniApp()).toBe(false);

    // Haptic vibration fallback in regular browser
    const vibrateCalls: number[] = [];
    (navigator as any).vibrate = (ms: number) => {
      vibrateCalls.push(ms);
      return true;
    };
    const { triggerHaptic } = await import('../lib/telegram');
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    expect(vibrateCalls.length).toBe(1);
    expect(vibrateCalls[0]).toBe(10);
  });

  it('validates VK client storage and bot commands helpers in lib/vk.ts', async () => {
    const {
      getSavedVkToken,
      saveVkToken,
      getSavedVkPeerId,
      saveVkPeerId,
      getVkBotCommands,
      sendVkMessage,
      VK_BOT_NAME,
      VK_COMMUNITY_URL,
      getSavedVkGroupId,
      saveVkGroupId,
      getVkBotDialogUrl,
      getVkCommunityUrl,
    } = await import('../lib/vk');

    expect(VK_BOT_NAME).toContain('VK');
    expect(VK_COMMUNITY_URL).toContain('vk.com');

    // Token storage
    saveVkToken('vk1.a.test_token_12345');
    expect(getSavedVkToken()).toBe('vk1.a.test_token_12345');
    saveVkToken('');
    expect(getSavedVkToken()).toBe('');

    // Peer ID storage
    saveVkPeerId('12345678');
    expect(getSavedVkPeerId()).toBe('12345678');
    saveVkPeerId('');
    expect(getSavedVkPeerId()).toBe('');

    // Group ID storage and dynamic URLs
    saveVkGroupId('987654321');
    expect(getSavedVkGroupId()).toBe('987654321');
    expect(getVkBotDialogUrl()).toContain('sel=-987654321');
    expect(getVkCommunityUrl()).toContain('club987654321');

    saveVkGroupId('club987654321');
    expect(getSavedVkGroupId()).toBe('club987654321');
    expect(getVkBotDialogUrl()).toContain('sel=-987654321');
    expect(getVkCommunityUrl()).toContain('club987654321');

    saveVkGroupId('');
    expect(getSavedVkGroupId()).toBe('');

    // Bot Commands catalog
    const commands = getVkBotCommands();
    expect(commands.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8);
    const cmdNames = commands.map((c) => c.command);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('start'))).toBe(true);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('vacancies'))).toBe(true);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('companies'))).toBe(true);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('roadmaps'))).toBe(true);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('questions'))).toBe(true);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('subscribe'))).toBe(true);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('status'))).toBe(true);
    expect(cmdNames.some((c) => c.includes('help'))).toBe(true);

    // sendVkMessage returns error if token is missing
    const sendRes = await sendVkMessage('123456', 'Hello', '');
    expect(sendRes.success).toBe(false);
    expect(sendRes.error).toContain('Token');
  });

  it('validates bot/vk_bot.mjs core functions, keyboards and HTML sanitizer', async () => {
    // @ts-ignore
    const vkBotModule: any = await import('../../bot/vk_bot.mjs');

    expect(vkBotModule).toBeDefined();

    // 1. cleanHtmlForVk
    expect(typeof vkBotModule.cleanHtmlForVk).toBe('function');
    const dirtyHtml = '🔥 <b>Новая стажировка!</b><br>Компания:&nbsp;<a href="https://t1.ru">Т1</a> &amp; <code>Java</code> &quot;Открытая школа&quot;';
    const cleaned = vkBotModule.cleanHtmlForVk(dirtyHtml);
    expect(cleaned).toContain('Новая стажировка!');
    expect(cleaned).not.toContain('<b>');
    expect(cleaned).not.toContain('</b>');
    expect(cleaned).not.toContain('<code>');
    expect(cleaned).not.toContain('&nbsp;');
    expect(cleaned).not.toContain('&amp;');
    expect(cleaned).not.toContain('&quot;');
    expect(cleaned).toContain('Т1 (https://t1.ru)');
    expect(cleaned).toContain('"Открытая школа"');

    // 2. createVkKeyboard
    expect(typeof vkBotModule.createVkKeyboard).toBe('function');
    const kbJson = vkBotModule.createVkKeyboard({
      inline: true,
      buttons: [
        [
          { label: 'Стажировки', payload: { cmd: 'vacancies' }, color: 'primary' },
          { label: 'Открыть IT-Старт', link: 'https://oioiqp.github.io/it-start/' },
        ],
      ],
    });
    const kb = JSON.parse(kbJson);
    expect(kb.inline).toBe(true);
    expect(kb.buttons.length).toBe(1);
    expect(kb.buttons[0][0].action.type).toBe('text');
    expect(kb.buttons[0][1].action.type).toBe('open_link');
    expect(kb.buttons[0][1].action.link).toBe('https://oioiqp.github.io/it-start/');

    // 2b. VK Mini App open_app and callback button generation
    const appKbJson = vkBotModule.createVkKeyboard({
      inline: true,
      buttons: [
        [
          { label: 'Запустить VK Mini App', app_id: 51820000, owner_id: 242573933 },
          { label: 'Кнопка Callback', type: 'callback', payload: { action: 'test' } },
        ],
      ],
    });
    const parsedAppKb = JSON.parse(appKbJson);
    expect(parsedAppKb.buttons[0][0].action.type).toBe('open_app');
    expect(parsedAppKb.buttons[0][0].action.app_id).toBe(51820000);
    expect(parsedAppKb.buttons[0][0].action.owner_id).toBe(242573933);
    expect(parsedAppKb.buttons[0][1].action.type).toBe('callback');

    const appTextMenu = vkBotModule.keyboardToTextMenu(appKbJson);
    expect(appTextMenu).toContain('https://vk.com/app51820000');

    // 3. formatVkVacancyMessage
    expect(typeof vkBotModule.formatVkVacancyMessage).toBe('function');
    const msg = vkBotModule.formatVkVacancyMessage({
      company: 'Холдинг Т1',
      title: 'Стажёр Java',
      salary: 'от 70 000 ₽',
      format: 'Удаленно',
      location: 'Москва',
      sourceChannel: '@t1career',
      tags: ['Java', 'Spring'],
      url: 'https://t1.ru/school/',
    });
    expect(msg).toContain('Холдинг Т1');
    expect(msg).toContain('Стажёр Java');
    expect(msg).toContain('от 70 000 ₽');
    expect(msg).toContain('https://t1.ru/school/');

    // 4. Predefined keyboards and VK API Inline 10-button limit
    expect(vkBotModule.MAIN_VK_KEYBOARD).toBeDefined();
    expect(vkBotModule.VACANCIES_VK_KEYBOARD).toBeDefined();
    expect(vkBotModule.COMPANIES_VK_KEYBOARD).toBeDefined();

    const mainKbParsed = JSON.parse(vkBotModule.MAIN_VK_KEYBOARD);
    expect(mainKbParsed.buttons.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    // Standard chat keyboard (inline: false) must use text buttons and avoid open_link
    mainKbParsed.buttons.flat().forEach((btn: any) => {
      expect(btn.action.type).not.toBe('open_link');
    });

    const vacKbParsed = JSON.parse(vkBotModule.VACANCIES_VK_KEYBOARD);
    const vacTotalButtons = vacKbParsed.buttons.flat().length;
    expect(vacTotalButtons).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10); // VK inline keyboard hard limit

    const compKbParsed = JSON.parse(vkBotModule.COMPANIES_VK_KEYBOARD);
    const compTotalButtons = compKbParsed.buttons.flat().length;
    expect(compTotalButtons).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10); // VK inline keyboard hard limit

    // 4b. Ensure open_app buttons in all predefined keyboards do NOT have owner_id (prevents foreign VPN blocks)
    const allPredefinedKeyboards = [
      vkBotModule.MAIN_VK_INLINE_KEYBOARD,
      vkBotModule.MAIN_VK_KEYBOARD,
      vkBotModule.VACANCIES_VK_KEYBOARD,
      vkBotModule.COMPANIES_VK_KEYBOARD,
    ];
    for (const kbStr of allPredefinedKeyboards) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(kbStr);
      parsed.buttons.flat().forEach((btn: any) => {
        if (btn.action && btn.action.type === 'open_app') {
          expect(btn.action.owner_id).toBeUndefined();
          expect(btn.action.app_id).toBeDefined();
        }
      });
    }
  });

  it('validates VK subscribers management and notification push in bot/vk_bot.mjs', async () => {
    // @ts-ignore
    const vkBotModule: any = await import('../../bot/vk_bot.mjs');

    // Reset deduplication cache
    if (typeof vkBotModule.clearVkNotifiedCache === 'function') {
      vkBotModule.clearVkNotifiedCache();
    }

    // Register subscriber
    await vkBotModule.registerVkSubscriber('999901', { first_name: 'Тестер' });
    const subs = await vkBotModule.getVkSubscribers();
    expect(subs.some((s: any) => s.peer_id === '999901')).toBe(true);

    const testVacancy = {
      id: 'test-vac-001',
      company: 'Холдинг Т1',
      title: 'Стажёр Java (Открытая школа)',
      salary: '80 000 ₽',
      format: 'Удаленно',
      sourceChannel: '@t1career',
      url: 'https://t1.ru/school/',
    };

    // First push notification to subscribers
    const sentCount1 = await vkBotModule.notifyVkSubscribers([testVacancy]);
    expect(sentCount1).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    // Second push with same vacancy should be deduplicated (sentCount === 0)
    const sentCount2 = await vkBotModule.notifyVkSubscribers([testVacancy]);
    expect(sentCount2).toBe(0);

    // Unregister
    await vkBotModule.unregisterVkSubscriber('999901');
    const subsAfter = await vkBotModule.getVkSubscribers();
    expect(subsAfter.some((s: any) => s.peer_id === '999901')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('validates fallback mode and runtime status of VK bot without token', async () => {
    // @ts-ignore
    const vkBotModule: any = await import('../../bot/vk_bot.mjs');

    const status = vkBotModule.getVkBotStatus();
    expect(status.bot).toContain('VK');
    expect(status.commandsCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8);
    expect(['live', 'fallback', 'configured']).toContain(status.mode);

    // Starting bot without token enters safe fallback mode without crashing
    const startRes = await vkBotModule.startVkBot('');
    expect(startRes.running).toBe(true);
    expect(startRes.mode).toBe('fallback');

    expect(() => vkBotModule.stopVkBot()).not.toThrow();
  });

describe('13. Real Employer Positions & Liquid Glass Bento Dark/Light Theme System', () => {
  it('covers 100% of required real programs for all 9 target employers', () => {
    // 1. Т-Банк: Frontend, Backend Python, Backend Go, Backend Java, QA, Analytics
    const tbankItems = SEED_INTERNSHIPS.filter((i) => i.company.toLowerCase().includes('т-банк'));
    expect(tbankItems.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(6);
    expect(tbankItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'frontend')).toBe(true);
    expect(tbankItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'backend' && i.subTrackId === 'python')).toBe(true);
    expect(tbankItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'backend' && i.subTrackId === 'golang')).toBe(true);
    expect(tbankItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'backend' && i.subTrackId === 'java')).toBe(true);
    expect(tbankItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'qa')).toBe(true);
    expect(tbankItems.some((i) => i.subTrackId === 'analytics')).toBe(true);
    tbankItems.forEach((i) => {
      expect(i.sourceChannel).toBe('@tbank_team');
      expect(i.applyUrl).toContain('education.tbank.ru');
    });

    // 2. СКБ Контур: Frontend React/TS, Backend C#/Python, QA
    const konturItems = SEED_INTERNSHIPS.filter((i) => i.company.toLowerCase().includes('контур'));
    expect(konturItems.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    expect(konturItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'frontend')).toBe(true);
    expect(konturItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'backend')).toBe(true);
    expect(konturItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'qa')).toBe(true);
    konturItems.forEach((i) => {
      expect(i.sourceChannel).toBe('@KonturTech');
      expect(i.applyUrl).toContain('kontur.ru');
    });

    // 3. Directum: Directum RX, C#, Web, QA
    const directumItems = SEED_INTERNSHIPS.filter((i) => i.company.toLowerCase().includes('directum'));
    expect(directumItems.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);

    expect(directumItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'backend')).toBe(true);
    expect(directumItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'qa')).toBe(true);
    directumItems.forEach((i) => {
      expect(i.location).toContain('Ижевск');
      expect(i.sourceChannel).toBe('@Life_in_Directum');
      expect(i.applyUrl).toContain('directum.ru');
    });

    // 4. Холдинг Т1: Java, DevOps/Linux, QA Auto
    const t1Items = SEED_INTERNSHIPS.filter((i) => i.company.toLowerCase().includes('т1'));
    expect(t1Items.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    expect(t1Items.some((i) => i.directionId === 'backend' && i.subTrackId === 'java')).toBe(true);
    expect(t1Items.some((i) => i.directionId === 'devops')).toBe(true);

    // 6. Ozon Tech: Go, C#, Frontend, QA

    expect(sberItems.some((i) => i.directionId === 'data_science')).toBe(true);

    expect(resolveApplyUrl('https://career.avito.com/internship', 'Авито')).toContain('/vacancies/razrabotka/');

    // 2. Direct Avito vacancy URL is preserved as-is

    // 5. Verify ALL 43 SEED_INTERNSHIPS have direct, non-search URLs
    expect(SEED_INTERNSHIPS.length).toBe(43);

      expect(item.applyUrl.startsWith('https://')).toBe(true);

    // 6. Verify bot ALL_INTERNSHIPS has exact parity with direct URLs

      expect(botItem.url).not.toContain('?search=');
```

## <a id="src-__tests__-bot_parity-test-ts"></a>26. `src/__tests__/bot_parity.test.ts`

- **Путь:** `src/__tests__/bot_parity.test.ts`
- **Назначение:** Автоматизированные тесты Vitest
- **Объем:** 587 строк (22.8 КБ)

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

describe('Bot Parity & Comprehensive Functionality Tests (Telegram & VKontakte)', { timeout: 25000 }, () => {
  let tgBot: any;
  let vkBot: any;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // @ts-ignore
    tgBot = await import('../../bot/bot.mjs');
    // @ts-ignore
    vkBot = await import('../../bot/vk_bot.mjs');
  });

  describe('1. Shared Data & Configuration Parity', () => {
    it('both bots share all 9 target employers', () => {
      expect(tgBot.COMPANIES_DATA).toBeDefined();
      expect(tgBot.COMPANIES_DATA.length).toBe(9);

      const expectedIds = ['t1', 'kontur', 'tbank', 'directum', 'yandex', 'ozon', 'sber', 'avito', 'vk'];
      expectedIds.forEach((id) => {
        const comp = tgBot.findCompanyByQuery(id);
        expect(comp).toBeDefined();
        expect(comp?.id).toBe(id);
      });
    });

    it('both bots share all 6 directions with aliases', () => {
      expect(tgBot.DIRECTION_ALIASES).toBeDefined();
      expect(vkBot.VK_DIRECTION_ALIASES).toBeDefined();

      const expectedDirs = ['frontend', 'backend', 'mobile', 'data_science', 'qa', 'devops'];
      expectedDirs.forEach((dir) => {
        expect(tgBot.DIRECTION_ALIASES[dir]).toBeDefined();
        expect(tgBot.DIRECTION_TITLES[dir]).toBeDefined();
        expect(tgBot.resolveDirectionByQuery(dir)).toBe(dir);
        expect(vkBot.resolveDirectionByQuery(dir)).toBe(dir);
      });

      // Russian synonyms
      expect(tgBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('фронтенд')).toBe('frontend');
      expect(tgBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('бэкенд')).toBe('backend');
      expect(tgBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('мобилка')).toBe('mobile');
      expect(tgBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('дата сайнс')).toBe('data_science');
      expect(tgBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('тестирование')).toBe('qa');
      expect(tgBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('девопс')).toBe('devops');

      expect(vkBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('фронтенд')).toBe('frontend');
      expect(vkBot.resolveDirectionByQuery('бэкенд')).toBe('backend');
    });

    it('both bots export status diagnostics', () => {
      const tgStatus = tgBot.getTgBotStatus();
      expect(tgStatus.bot).toBe('IT-Старт Telegram Бот');
      expect(tgStatus.commandsCount).toBe(12);
      expect(tgStatus.channelsCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(tgStatus.websitesCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(tgStatus.subscribersCount).toBeDefined();

      const vkStatus = vkBot.getVkBotStatus();
      expect(vkStatus.bot).toBe('IT-Старт VK Бот');
      expect(vkStatus.commandsCount).toBe(12);
      expect(vkStatus.channelsCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(vkStatus.websitesCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(vkStatus.companiesCount).toBe(9);
      expect(vkStatus.subscribersCount).toBeDefined();
      expect(vkStatus.version).toBe('5.199');
    });
  });

  describe('2. Telegram Bot Command Suite & Fallback', () => {
    const mockChatId = 778899;

    it('handles /start and Russian greetings', async () => {
      const resStart = await tgBot.handleMessage({
        chat: { id: mockChatId },
        text: '/start',
        from: { first_name: 'Алексей', username: 'alex_tg' },
      });
      expect(resStart.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(resStart.type).toBe('start');
      expect(resStart.replyText).toContain('Алексей');
      expect(resStart.replyText).toContain(String(mockChatId));

      const resHello = await tgBot.handleMessage({
        chat: { id: mockChatId },
        text: 'Привет!',
        from: { first_name: 'Алексей', username: 'alex_tg' },
      });
      expect(resHello.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(resHello.type).toBe('start');
    });

    it('handles /vacancies and direction filters', async () => {
      // All vacancies
      const resAll = await tgBot.handleMessage({
        chat: { id: mockChatId },
        text: '/vacancies',
      });
      expect(resAll.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(resAll.type).toBe('vacancies');
      expect(resAll.filter).toBe('all');
      expect(resAll.count).toBeGreaterThan(0);

      // Direction argument: frontend
      const resFront = await tgBot.handleMessage({
        chat: { id: mockChatId },
        text: '/vacancies frontend',
      });
      expect(resFront.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(resFront.type).toBe('vacancies');
      expect(resFront.filter).toBe('frontend');

      // Russian direction text directly: «бэкенд»
      const resBack = await tgBot.handleMessage({
        chat: { id: mockChatId },
        text: 'бэкенд',
      });
      expect(resBack.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(resBack.type).toBe('vacancies');
      expect(resBack.filter).toBe('backend');

      // Company argument: /vacancies t1
      const resComp = await tgBot.handleMessage({
        chat: { id: mockChatId },
        text: '/vacancies t1',
      });
      expect(resComp.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(resComp.type).toBe('company_details');
      expect(resComp.companyId).toBe('t1');
    });

  describe('3. VK Bot Command Suite & Parity', () => {

        const res = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({ peer_id: mockPeerId, text: `/company_${compId}` });

        expect(res.type).toBe('company_details');
        expect(res.company).toBe(compId);

      // Reset menu state to main

      // 8 -> help

      expect(res8.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(res8.type).toBe('help');

      // 9 -> id
      const res9 = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({ peer_id: mockPeerId, text: '9' });
      expect(res9.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(res9.type).toBe('id');
    });

    it('handles /tg, /vk, "веб", and Russian prefix vacancies in VK', async () => {
      // /tg
      const resTg = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({ peer_id: mockPeerId, text: '/tg' });

      expect(resTg.type).toBe('tg');
      expect(resTg.reply.message).toContain('Telegram');

      // /vk
      const resVk = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({ peer_id: mockPeerId, text: '/vk' });

      expect(resVk.type).toBe('vk');

      // 'веб' must open site
      const resWeb = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({ peer_id: mockPeerId, text: 'веб' });

  describe('4. Full Cross-Platform Feature Parity Matrix', () => {
    it('both bots support the complete list of 13 functional commands', async () => {
      const commands = [
        'start',
        'vacancies',
        'companies',
        'roadmaps',
        'questions',
        'subscribe',
        'unsubscribe',
        'id',
        'status',
        'site',
        'help',
        'vk',
        'tg',

      for (const cmd of commands) {
        const tgRes = await tgBot.handleMessage({
          chat: { id: 123000 },
          text: `/${cmd}`,
          from: { username: 'testuser', first_name: 'Тестер' },
        });
        expect(tgRes.ok).toBe(true);
        expect(tgRes.type).toBeDefined();

        const vkRes = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({
          peer_id: 123000,
          text: `/${cmd}`,
        });
        expect(vkRes.ok).toBe(true);
        expect(vkRes.type).toBeDefined();
      }
    }, 30000);

    it('both bots synchronize subscriber persistence and offline resilience', async () => {
      const testId = 445566;

      // TG subscriber
      const tgSub = await tgBot.registerTgSubscriber(testId, { username: 'tester_parity', first_name: 'Тестер' });
      expect(tgSub.chat_id).toBe(String(testId));
      expect(tgSub.is_active).toBe(true);

      const tgUnsub = await tgBot.unregisterTgSubscriber(testId);
      expect(typeof tgUnsub).toBe('boolean');

      // VK subscriber
      const vkSub = await vkBot.registerVkSubscriber(testId, { first_name: 'Тестер VK' });
      expect(vkSub.peer_id).toBe(String(testId));
      expect(vkSub.is_active).toBe(true);

      const vkUnsub = await vkBot.unregisterVkSubscriber(testId);
      expect(vkUnsub).toBe(true);
    }, 30000);

    it('verifies that Telegram bot isolates VK subscribers and never sends push to vk_ IDs', async () => {
      // Register a VK subscriber with vk_ prefix in memory
      const vkPeerId = 998877;
      await vkBot.registerVkSubscriber(vkPeerId, { first_name: 'VK Tester' });

      // In tg_subscriptions, VK subscribers have prefix "vk_"
      // Verify that tgSubscribers only contains valid Telegram chat IDs
      for (const [chatId] of tgBot.tgSubscribers.entries()) {
        expect(String(chatId).startsWith('vk_')).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    it('validates unified subscription service and VK push preference filtering', async () => {
      const {
        normalizeVkChatId,
        stripVkPrefix,
        saveUnifiedSubscription,
      } = await import('../services/subscriptionService');

      // Test normalization
      expect(normalizeVkChatId('12345')).toBe('vk_12345');
      expect(normalizeVkChatId('vk_12345')).toBe('vk_12345');
      expect(stripVkPrefix('vk_12345')).toBe('12345');
      expect(stripVkPrefix('12345')).toBe('12345');

      // Test saving unified VK subscription
      const saveRes = await saveUnifiedSubscription({
        platform: 'vk',
        id: '556677',
        username: 'vk_user',
        firstName: 'Виктор',
        directions: ['frontend'],
        subTracks: ['react'],
      });
      expect(saveRes.success).toBe(true);
      expect(saveRes.subscription.chat_id).toBe('vk_556677');
      expect(saveRes.subscription.directions).toEqual(['frontend']);

      // Isolate subscriber map for deterministic preference filtering check
      const savedSubs = new Map(vkBot.vkSubscribers);
      vkBot.vkSubscribers.clear();
      vkBot.clearVkNotifiedCache();

      // Register subscriber with only 'frontend' direction
      await vkBot.registerVkSubscriber('556677', {
        first_name: 'Виктор',
        directions: ['frontend'],
        sub_tracks: ['react'],
      });

      // Vacancy with 'backend' should NOT be delivered to frontend subscriber
      const backendVac = {
        id: 'vac-backend-999',
        company: 'Т-Банк',
        title: 'Стажёр Go / Python',
        salary: '100 000 ₽',
        format: 'Удаленно',
        directionId: 'backend',
        subTrackId: 'golang',
      };
      const sentBackend = await vkBot.notifyVkSubscribers([backendVac]);
      expect(sentBackend).toBe(0);

      // Vacancy with 'frontend' SHOULD be delivered
      const frontendVac = {
        id: 'vac-frontend-999',
        company: 'Яндекс',
        title: 'Стажёр Frontend (React)',
        salary: '110 000 ₽',
        format: 'Удаленно',
        directionId: 'frontend',
        subTrackId: 'react',
      };
      const sentFrontend = await vkBot.notifyVkSubscribers([frontendVac]);
      expect(sentFrontend).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

      // Restore subscribers map
      vkBot.vkSubscribers.clear();
      for (const [k, v] of savedSubs.entries()) {
        vkBot.vkSubscribers.set(k, v);
      }
    });

    it('verifies isMessagesFromGroupAllowed and sendVkNotification helpers', async () => {
      // 1. isMessagesFromGroupAllowed
      const allowedRes = await vkBot.isMessagesFromGroupAllowed('vk_123456');
      expect(allowedRes.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(typeof allowedRes.is_allowed).toBe('boolean');

      // 2. sendVkNotification without token in test mode
      const sendRes = await vkBot.sendVkNotification('vk_123456', '<b>Жирный текст</b> и ссылка <a href="https://example.com">Тут</a>');
      expect(sendRes.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(sendRes.messageId).toBeDefined();

      // 3. sendVkNotification validates empty peer_id
      const emptyRes = await vkBot.sendVkNotification('', 'Тест');
      expect(emptyRes.ok).toBe(false);
      expect(emptyRes.error).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('verifies that subscribers with empty or null directions receive all vacancies', async () => {
      const savedSubs = new Map(vkBot.vkSubscribers);
      vkBot.vkSubscribers.clear();
      vkBot.clearVkNotifiedCache();

      // Register subscriber with empty directions array
      await vkBot.registerVkSubscriber('112233', {
        first_name: 'Всеядный Студент',
        directions: [],
        sub_tracks: [],
      });

      const anyVac = {
        id: 'vac-all-101',
        company: 'Ozon',
        title: 'Стажёр Аналитик',
        salary: '100 000 ₽',
        format: 'Удаленно',
        directionId: 'data_science',
      };

      const deliveredCount = await vkBot.notifyVkSubscribers([anyVac]);
      expect(deliveredCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

      // Restore subscribers
      vkBot.vkSubscribers.clear();
      for (const [k, v] of savedSubs.entries()) {
        vkBot.vkSubscribers.set(k, v);
      }
    });

    it('validates /id and /status commands reflect active subscribers correctly', async () => {
      // Ensure /id and /status succeed
      const idRes = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({ peer_id: 123456, text: '/id' });
      expect(idRes.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(idRes.reply.message).toContain('Ваш идентификатор ВКонтакте');

      const statusRes = await vkBot.handleVkMessage({ peer_id: 123456, text: '/status' });
      expect(statusRes.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(statusRes.reply.message).toContain('Статус сервиса IT-Старт');
      expect(statusRes.reply.message).toContain('Активных подписчиков в VK');
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';

  completedTopics: [],

  completedQuestions: [],
  repeatQuestions: [],
};

describe('16. Comprehensive Responsive & Adaptive Layout Suite', () => {

      const { Navbar } = await import('../components/Navbar');
      const html = renderToString(
        React.createElement(Navbar, {
          activeTab: 'internships',
          setActiveTab: () => {},
          telegramUser: null,
          vkUser: null,
          isVk: false,
          onOpenSubscribeModal: () => {},
        })
      );

      // Flex child min-w-0 ensures container shrinks properly on narrow screens
      expect(html).toContain('min-w-0');

      expect(html).toContain('px-2 sm:px-4');
      expect(html).toContain('py-1.5 sm:py-2');
    });

    it('incorporates VK safe area inset right to avoid overlapping VK client top-right menu', async () => {
      const { Navbar } = await import('../components/Navbar');
      const html = renderToString(
        React.createElement(Navbar, {
          activeTab: 'internships',

          telegramUser: null,
          vkUser: { id: 12345, first_name: 'Анна' },
          isVk: true,
          onOpenSubscribeModal: () => {},
        })
      );

      // Must account for VK Mini App system header menu on the right

    it('renders compact user profile capsule with truncation on narrow screens', async () => {

      );

      expect(html).toContain('truncate');
      expect(html).toContain('max-w-[100px]');
      expect(html).toContain('Константинопольский');

  });

  describe('InternshipCard Responsive Layout', () => {

  describe('InternshipModal Responsive Adaptation', () => {
```

## <a id="src-__tests__-vacancy_quality-test-ts"></a>28. `src/__tests__/vacancy_quality.test.ts`

- **Путь:** `src/__tests__/vacancy_quality.test.ts`
- **Назначение:** Автоматизированные тесты Vitest
- **Объем:** 199 строк (13.4 КБ)

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  formatSalary,
  isStrictVacancyPost,
  resolveApplyUrl,
  detectVacancyTrack,
} from '../lib/vacancyUrl';
import { SEED_INTERNSHIPS } from '../data/internships';

describe('Vacancy Quality & Link Integrity Verification', () => {
  describe('1. formatSalary', () => {
    it('returns standard "По договорённости" for empty / null / non-salary markers', () => {
      expect(formatSalary(null)).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary(undefined)).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary('')).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary('По договоренности')).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary('По договорённости')).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary('договорная')).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary('Оплачиваемая стажировка')).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary('оплачиваемая')).toBe('По договорённости');
      expect(formatSalary('не указана')).toBe('По договорённости');
    });

    it('formats salary object ranges cleanly', () => {
      expect(formatSalary({ from: 50000, to: 75000 })).toBe('от 50 000 до 75 000 ₽');
      expect(formatSalary({ from: 60000 })).toBe('от 60 000 ₽');
      expect(formatSalary({ to: 80000 })).toBe('до 80 000 ₽');
      expect(formatSalary({ amount: 70000 })).toBe('70 000 ₽');
    });

    it('formats raw string ranges with proper spaces and ₽ symbol', () => {
      expect(formatSalary('от 50 000 до 75 000 руб')).toBe('от 50 000 до 75 000 ₽');
      expect(formatSalary('60-80k')).toBe('от 60 000 до 80 000 ₽');
      expect(formatSalary('от 70 тыс руб')).toBe('от 70 000 ₽');
      expect(formatSalary('до 100 000 ₽')).toBe('до 100 000 ₽');
      expect(formatSalary('85000 ₽')).toBe('85 000 ₽');
    });

    it('preserves already clean ranges', () => {
      expect(formatSalary('от 65 000 до 85 000 ₽')).toBe('от 65 000 до 85 000 ₽');
    });
  });

  describe('2. isStrictVacancyPost', () => {
    it('accepts all 43 canonical SEED_INTERNSHIPS', () => {
      for (const item of SEED_INTERNSHIPS) {
        const isValid = isStrictVacancyPost(item.title, item.description);
        expect(isValid, `SEED item ${item.id} (${item.title}) should pass validator`).toBe(true);
      }
    });

    it('rejects marketing, courses, webinars and PR celebrations', () => {
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Стать аналитиком данных всего за 10 недель', 'Курс с гарантией трудоустройства')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Подкаст про IT карьеру', 'Слушайте новый выпуск')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Поздравляем с 8 марта!', 'Дарим мерч и подарки')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Опрос: какую IDE вы используете?', 'Голосуйте в канале')).toBe(false);
      // Real Telegram news / conference / event / outage posts
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('По следам нашей поездки на DotNext ребята сами, без ИИ, сделали ролик...', 'За два дня конференции мы выступили с докладами')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Делаем в Новосибирске батл для backend-разработчиков 🎉', 'Kontur Verse — архитектурная игра')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('В ближайшие дни доля доступных файлов будет увеличиваться . При это...', 'Инженеры Яндекса делают всё возможное')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('rejects non-IT roles (sales, support, legal, accounting, logistics, HR, infosec)', () => {
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Младший специалист по продажам', 'B2B продажи')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Оператор call-центра', 'Прием входящих звонков')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Младший юрист', 'Договорная работа')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Помощник бухгалтера', 'Первичная документация')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Курьер на доставку', 'Доставка заказов')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Младший рекрутер в HR', 'Подбор персонала')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Младший специалист по фрод-мониторингу', 'Антифрод')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Младший риск-менеджер (недвижимость)', 'Оценка рисков')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Младший инженер КИПиА', 'Автоматика')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('1С-программист стажер', 'Доработка конфигураций 1С')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Инженер по информационной безопасности', 'Защита данных')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Младший инженер по информационной безопасности', 'Безопасность')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('rejects senior/lead/middle roles without internship indicator', () => {
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Senior Python Developer', 'Разработка сервисов')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Старший разработчик React', 'Команда разработки')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Руководитель группы тестирования', 'Управление QA')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Middle Java Developer', 'Разработка бэкенда')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Мидл бэкенд разработчик', 'Сервисы')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Ведущий инженер по качеству', 'QA')).toBe(false);
      // General non-internship developer positions without junior/intern keywords
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Scala разработчик', 'Разработка на Scala')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Go-разработчик, Товародвижение и коммерция', 'Микросервисы')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Бэкенд разработчик Java | Python | Go | C++', 'Высокие нагрузки')).toBe(false);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Разработчик на Java в команду B2B-платформы Яндекс 360', 'B2B')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('accepts legitimate junior / internship engineering roles across 6 directions', () => {
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Стажёр Frontend разработчик', 'React, TypeScript')).toBe(true);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Junior Backend Engineer', 'Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL')).toBe(true);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Стажёр Flutter разработчик', 'Мобильная разработка')).toBe(true);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Junior QA Automation', 'Автоматизация тестирования на Java')).toBe(true);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Стажёр DevOps / SRE', 'Kubernetes, CI/CD, Docker')).toBe(true);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Стажёр Data Scientist', 'ML, Python, PyTorch')).toBe(true);
      expect(isStrictVacancyPost('Стажёр Backend C# / .NET Developer (Directum RX)', 'Разработка ядра платформы')).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('3. resolveApplyUrl & direct portals', () => {
    it('strips all search and direction query parameters', () => {
      expect(resolveApplyUrl('https://career.avito.com/vacancies/?search=android', 'Авито', undefined, 'mobile'))
        .not.toContain('?search=');
      expect(resolveApplyUrl('https://career.t1.ru/vacancies/?search=java', 'Холдинг Т1', undefined, 'backend'))
        .not.toContain('?search=');
      expect(resolveApplyUrl('https://education.tbank.ru/start/?direction=sre', 'Т-Банк', undefined, 'devops'))
        .not.toContain('?direction=');
      expect(resolveApplyUrl('https://kontur.ru/career/vacancies?search=react', 'Контур', undefined, 'frontend'))
        .not.toContain('?search=');
    });

    it('resolves relative job board and Avito vacancy URLs properly without triple slashes', () => {
      expect(resolveApplyUrl('/vacancy/138722040?query=sber', 'Сбер', undefined, 'backend'))
        .toBe('https://hh.ru/vacancy/138722040');
      expect(resolveApplyUrl('/vacancies/1000168452', 'Яндекс', undefined, 'backend'))
        .toBe('https://career.habr.com/vacancies/1000168452');
      expect(resolveApplyUrl('/vacancies/razrabotka/20812/', 'Авито', undefined, 'backend'))
        .toBe('https://career.avito.com/vacancies/razrabotka/20812/');
    });

    it('resolves generic homepages to directional direct portals', () => {
      const avitoDirect = resolveApplyUrl('https://career.avito.com/', 'Авито', undefined, 'mobile');
      expect(avitoDirect).toBe('https://career.avito.com/vacancies/razrabotka/20803/');

      const avitoDevops = resolveApplyUrl('https://career.avito.com', 'Авито', undefined, 'devops');
      expect(avitoDevops).toBe('https://career.avito.com/vacancies/razrabotka/20803/');

      const avitoSearch = resolveApplyUrl('https://career.avito.com/vacancies/?search=стажер', 'Авито', undefined, 'frontend');
      expect(avitoSearch).toBe('https://career.avito.com/vacancies/razrabotka/20803/');

      const tbankDirect = resolveApplyUrl('https://tbank.ru', 'Т-Банк', undefined, 'frontend');
      expect(tbankDirect).toBe('https://education.tbank.ru/start/frontend/');

      const konturDirect = resolveApplyUrl('https://kontur.ru', 'Контур', undefined, 'frontend');
      expect(konturDirect).toBe('https://kontur.ru/career/vacancies/intern-frontend');

      const sberDirect = resolveApplyUrl('https://sbergraduate.ru', 'Сбер', undefined, 'data_science');
      expect(sberDirect).toBe('https://sbergraduate.ru/sberseasons-moscow/ml/');

      const directumDirect = resolveApplyUrl('https://career.directum.ru', 'Directum', undefined, 'frontend');
      expect(directumDirect).toBe('https://career.directum.ru/vacancy/');

      const directumLead = resolveApplyUrl('https://career.directum.ru/lead_product_ownerRX', 'Directum', undefined, 'backend');
      expect(directumLead).toBe('https://career.directum.ru/vacancy/');
    });

    it('preserves valid Telegram post URLs with post IDs', () => {
      const tgUrl = 'https://t.me/t1career/264';
      expect(resolveApplyUrl(tgUrl, 'Холдинг Т1', '@t1career', 'backend')).toBe(tgUrl);
    });

    it('preserves valid direct company vacancy URLs with ID or slug', () => {
      const directHabr = 'https://career.habr.com/vacancies/1000168452';
      expect(resolveApplyUrl(directHabr, 'Яндекс', undefined, 'backend')).toBe(directHabr);

      const directHh = 'https://hh.ru/vacancy/119567843';
      expect(resolveApplyUrl(directHh, 'СКБ Контур', undefined, 'qa')).toBe(directHh);
    });
  });

  describe('4. detectVacancyTrack', () => {
    it('detects Frontend tracks accurately', () => {
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Стажёр Frontend React').directionId).toBe('frontend');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Junior Angular Developer').directionId).toBe('frontend');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Vue.js веб-разработчик').directionId).toBe('frontend');
    });

    it('detects Backend tracks accurately', () => {
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Стажёр Python Backend').directionId).toBe('backend');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Junior Golang Developer').directionId).toBe('backend');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Java Spring Boot стажёр').directionId).toBe('backend');
    });

    it('detects Mobile tracks accurately', () => {
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Junior Android Kotlin Developer').directionId).toBe('mobile');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Стажёр iOS Swift Developer').directionId).toBe('mobile');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Flutter Mobile Developer').directionId).toBe('mobile');
    });

    it('detects QA tracks accurately', () => {
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Стажёр QA-инженер (ручное тестирование)').directionId).toBe('qa');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Junior QA Automation Python').directionId).toBe('qa');
    });

    it('detects DevOps tracks accurately', () => {
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Стажёр SRE / DevOps').directionId).toBe('devops');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Junior Kubernetes Engineer').directionId).toBe('devops');
    });

    it('detects Data Science tracks accurately', () => {
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Стажёр ML / Data Science').directionId).toBe('data_science');
      expect(detectVacancyTrack('Junior Аналитик данных').directionId).toBe('data_science');
    });

});
```

```typescript
  saveSubscriptionToSupabase,
  TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME,
  TELEGRAM_BOT_URL,
  GITHUB_PAGES_URL,
} from './lib/supabase';
import {
  getCachedInternships,
  getLocalProgress,
  getLocalSubscription,
  saveLocalSubscription,
  saveCachedInternships,
  saveLocalProgress,
  saveLocalTheme,
} from './lib/storage';
import { initTelegramWebApp, triggerHaptic } from './lib/telegram';
import {
  initVkBridge,
  isVkMiniApp,
  getCachedVkUser,
  getVkLaunchParams,
  type VkUser,
  type VkLaunchParams,
} from './lib/vkBridge';
import { VK_COMMUNITY_URL, saveVkPeerId } from './lib/vk';
import { RENDER_URL } from './services/subscriptionService';

export function App() {
  // Navigation
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'internships' | 'roadmaps' | 'questions' | 'telegram'>('internships');

  // Telegram User & Subscription
  const [telegramUser, setTelegramUser] = useState<TelegramUser | null>(() => initTelegramWebApp());
  const [currentSubscription, setCurrentSubscription] = useState<TelegramSubscription | null>(() => getLocalSubscription());
  const [isSubscribeModalOpen, setIsSubscribeModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // VK Mini App User & Params
  const [vkUser, setVkUser] = useState<VkUser | null>(() => {
    const cached = getCachedVkUser();
    if (cached) return cached;
    const lp = getVkLaunchParams();
    if (lp.vk_user_id) {
      return { id: lp.vk_user_id, first_name: 'Пользователь VK' };
    }
    return null;
  });
  const [_vkLaunchParams, setVkLaunchParams] = useState<VkLaunchParams>(() => getVkLaunchParams());
  const [isVk, setIsVk] = useState<boolean>(() => isVkMiniApp());

  // User Progress
  const [userProgress, setUserProgress] = useState<UserProgress>(() => getLocalProgress());

  // Internships state
  const [internships, setInternships] = useState<Internship[]>(() => {
    const cached = getCachedInternships();
    return cached.length > 0 ? cached : SEED_INTERNSHIPS;
  });
  const [isLoadingInternships, setIsLoadingInternships] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [selectedInternshipForPlan, setSelectedInternshipForPlan] = useState<Internship | null>(null);

  // Internships Filters
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedCompany, setSelectedCompany] = useState<string>('all');
  const [selectedDirection, setSelectedDirection] = useState<DirectionId | 'all'>('all');
  const [selectedSubTrack, setSelectedSubTrack] = useState<SubTrackId | 'all'>('all');
  const [selectedFormat, setSelectedFormat] = useState<WorkFormat | 'all'>('all');
  const [selectedSource, setSelectedSource] = useState<'all' | 'telegram' | 'portal'>('all');
  const [isMobileFiltersOpen, setIsMobileFiltersOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const TARGET_COMPANIES = [
    'Т-Банк',
    'Холдинг Т1',
    'Контур',
    'Directum',
    'Яндекс',
    'Ozon Tech',
    'Сбер',
    'Авито',
    'VK',
  ];

  // Enforce pure serene light mode (Apple Platinum Minimalist)
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const metaThemeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    root.classList.add('light');
    root.classList.remove('dark');
    document.body.classList.add('light');
    document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    if (metaThemeColor) metaThemeColor.setAttribute('content', '#dbe0ea');
    saveLocalTheme('light');
  }, []);

  // Initialize Telegram WebApp, VK Mini App & Supabase
  useEffect(() => {
    const syncTelegramAutoSubscription = (u: TelegramUser) => {
      const existing = getLocalSubscription();
      if (!existing || String(existing.chat_id) !== String(u.id) || !existing.is_active) {
        const autoSub: TelegramSubscription = {
          chat_id: String(u.id),
          username: u.username || existing?.username || '',
          first_name: u.first_name || existing?.first_name || 'Пользователь Telegram',
          directions: existing?.directions?.length
            ? existing.directions
            : ['frontend', 'backend', 'mobile', 'qa', 'devops', 'data_science'],
          sub_tracks: existing?.sub_tracks?.length
            ? existing.sub_tracks
            : ['react', 'python', 'nodejs', 'golang', 'auto_qa', 'cicd_docker'],
          is_active: true,
          created_at: existing?.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        saveLocalSubscription(autoSub);
        setCurrentSubscription(autoSub);
        saveSubscriptionToSupabase(autoSub);
      }
    };

    // 1. Detect Telegram WebApp
    const user = initTelegramWebApp();
    if (user) {
      setTelegramUser(user);
      syncTelegramAutoSubscription(user);
    } else {
      let checks = 0;
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        checks++;
        const delayedUser = initTelegramWebApp();
        if (delayedUser) {
          setTelegramUser(delayedUser);
          syncTelegramAutoSubscription(delayedUser);
          clearInterval(interval);
        } else if (checks >= 20) {
          clearInterval(interval);
        }
      }, 150);
    }

    const syncVkAutoSubscription = (u: VkUser) => {
      const vkKey = `vk_${u.id}`;
      const existing = getLocalSubscription();
      if (!existing || String(existing.chat_id) !== vkKey || !existing.is_active) {
        const autoSub: TelegramSubscription = {
          chat_id: vkKey,
          username: `${u.first_name || ''} ${u.last_name || ''}`.trim(),
          first_name: u.first_name || 'Пользователь VK',
          directions: existing?.directions?.length
            ? existing.directions
            : ['frontend', 'backend', 'mobile', 'qa', 'devops', 'data_science'],
          sub_tracks: existing?.sub_tracks?.length
            ? existing.sub_tracks
            : ['react', 'python', 'nodejs', 'golang', 'auto_qa', 'cicd_docker'],
          is_active: true,
          created_at: existing?.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        saveVkPeerId(String(u.id));
        saveLocalSubscription(autoSub);
        setCurrentSubscription(autoSub);
        saveSubscriptionToSupabase(autoSub);

        const serverUrl = RENDER_URL.endsWith('/') ? RENDER_URL.slice(0, -1) : RENDER_URL;
        fetch(`${serverUrl}/subscribe`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            chatId: vkKey,
            username: autoSub.username,
            firstName: autoSub.first_name,
            directions: autoSub.directions,
            sub_tracks: autoSub.sub_tracks,
            platform: 'vk',
          }),
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
    };

    // 2. Detect and initialize VK Mini App
    initVkBridge()
      .then((res) => {
        if (res.user) {
          setVkUser(res.user);
          syncVkAutoSubscription(res.user);
        }
        setVkLaunchParams(res.launchParams);
        setIsVk(isVkMiniApp());
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    // 3. Load cached subscription
    const localSub = getLocalSubscription();
    if (localSub) {
      setCurrentSubscription(localSub);
    }

    // 3. Fetch internships from Supabase & Seed if empty
    const syncInternships = async () => {
      setIsLoadingInternships(true);
      const data = await fetchInternshipsFromSupabase();

      if (data && data.length > 0) {
        setInternships(data);
        saveCachedInternships(data);
      } else if (data && data.length === 0) {
        // Table is empty, seed initial data
        console.log('Seeding initial internships to Supabase...');
        await seedInternshipsToSupabase(SEED_INTERNSHIPS);
        setInternships(SEED_INTERNSHIPS);
        saveCachedInternships(SEED_INTERNSHIPS);
      } else {
        // Fallback to seed data
        setInternships(SEED_INTERNSHIPS);
      }
      setIsLoadingInternships(false);
    };

    syncInternships();
  }, []);

  // Save progress helper
  const updateProgress = (updater: (prev: UserProgress) => UserProgress) => {
    setUserProgress((prev) => {
      const next = updater(prev);
      saveLocalProgress(next);

      const userId = telegramUser?.id || vkUser?.id || currentSubscription?.chat_id || 'anonymous';
      saveUserProgressToSupabase(userId, next);

      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleToggleTopic = (topicId: string) => {
    updateProgress((prev) => {
      const isCompleted = prev.completedTopics.includes(topicId);
      const topic = ROADMAP_TOPICS.find((t) => t.id === topicId);
      const subtopicIds = topic ? topic.subtopics.map((_, idx) => `${topicId}__sub_${idx}`) : [];
      const currentSubSet = new Set(prev.completedSubtopics || []);

      if (!isCompleted) {
        subtopicIds.forEach((sid) => currentSubSet.add(sid));
        return {
          ...prev,
          completedTopics: prev.completedTopics.includes(topicId)
            ? prev.completedTopics
            : [...prev.completedTopics, topicId],
          completedSubtopics: Array.from(currentSubSet),
        };
      } else {
        subtopicIds.forEach((sid) => currentSubSet.delete(sid));
        return {
          ...prev,
          completedTopics: prev.completedTopics.filter((id) => id !== topicId),
          completedSubtopics: Array.from(currentSubSet),
        };
      }
    });
  };

  const handleToggleSubtopic = (topicId: string, subtopicIndex: number) => {
    updateProgress((prev) => {
      const topic = ROADMAP_TOPICS.find((t) => t.id === topicId);
      const totalSubtopics = topic?.subtopics.length || 0;
      const allTopicSubIds = topic?.subtopics.map((_, idx) => `${topicId}__sub_${idx}`) || [];
      const targetSubId = `${topicId}__sub_${subtopicIndex}`;

      const currentSubSet = new Set(prev.completedSubtopics || []);
      const wasTopicCompleted = prev.completedTopics.includes(topicId);

      if (wasTopicCompleted) {
        allTopicSubIds.forEach((sid) => currentSubSet.add(sid));
      }

      if (currentSubSet.has(targetSubId)) {
        currentSubSet.delete(targetSubId);
      } else {
        currentSubSet.add(targetSubId);
      }

      const nextSubtopics = Array.from(currentSubSet);
      const completedCount = allTopicSubIds.filter((sid) => currentSubSet.has(sid)).length;
      const isAllDone = totalSubtopics > 0 && completedCount === totalSubtopics;

      let nextCompletedTopics = [...prev.completedTopics];
      if (isAllDone && !nextCompletedTopics.includes(topicId)) {
        nextCompletedTopics.push(topicId);
      } else if (!isAllDone && nextCompletedTopics.includes(topicId)) {
        nextCompletedTopics = nextCompletedTopics.filter((id) => id !== topicId);
      }

      return {
        ...prev,
        completedTopics: nextCompletedTopics,
        completedSubtopics: nextSubtopics,
      };
    });
  };

  const handleToggleQuestion = (questionId: string) => {
    updateProgress((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.completedQuestions.includes(questionId);
      return {
        ...prev,
        completedQuestions: exists
          ? prev.completedQuestions.filter((id) => id !== questionId)
          : [...prev.completedQuestions, questionId],
        repeatQuestions: prev.repeatQuestions.filter((id) => id !== questionId),
      };
    });
  };

  const handleMarkQuestionRepeat = (questionId: string) => {
    updateProgress((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      repeatQuestions: Array.from(new Set([...prev.repeatQuestions, questionId])),
      completedQuestions: prev.completedQuestions.filter((id) => id !== questionId),
    }));
  };

  const handleMarkQuestionLearned = (questionId: string) => {
    updateProgress((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      completedQuestions: Array.from(new Set([...prev.completedQuestions, questionId])),
      repeatQuestions: prev.repeatQuestions.filter((id) => id !== questionId),
    }));
  };

  const handleInternshipAdded = (newInternship: Internship) => {
    setInternships((prev) => {
      const next = [newInternship, ...prev];
      saveCachedInternships(next);
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Helper for matching companies with synonyms
  const matchesCompanyFilter = (companyName: string, targetCompany: string): boolean => {
    if (targetCompany === 'all') return true;
    const c = companyName.toLowerCase();
    const t = targetCompany.toLowerCase();
    if (c.includes(t) || t.includes(c)) return true;
    if (t.includes('directum') || t.includes('директ')) return c.includes('directum') || c.includes('директ');
    if (t.includes('т1') || t.includes('t1')) return c.includes('т1') || c.includes('t1');
    if (t.includes('контур') || t.includes('kontur')) return c.includes('контур') || c.includes('kontur');
    if (t.includes('т-банк') || t.includes('тбанк') || t.includes('тиньк')) return c.includes('т-банк') || c.includes('тинькофф') || c.includes('тбанк');
    if (t.includes('авито') || t.includes('avito')) return c.includes('авито') || c.includes('avito');
    if (t.includes('ozon') || t.includes('озон')) return c.includes('ozon') || c.includes('озон');
    if (t.includes('сбер') || t.includes('sber')) return c.includes('сбер') || c.includes('sber');
    if (t.includes('vk') || t.includes('вк') || t.includes('вконтакт')) return c.includes('vk') || c.includes('вк') || c.includes('вконтакт');
    if (t.includes('яндекс') || t.includes('yandex')) return c.includes('яндекс') || c.includes('yandex');
    return false;
  };

  // Filtered internships for feed
  const filteredInternships = internships.filter((item) => {
    if (selectedCompany !== 'all' && !matchesCompanyFilter(item.company, selectedCompany)) {
      return false;
    }
    if (selectedDirection !== 'all' && item.directionId !== selectedDirection) return false;
    if (selectedSubTrack !== 'all' && item.subTrackId !== selectedSubTrack) return false;
    if (selectedFormat !== 'all' && item.format !== selectedFormat) return false;
    if (selectedSource === 'telegram' && item.sourceType !== 'telegram') return false;
    if (selectedSource === 'portal' && item.sourceType !== 'portal') return false;

    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const isDirectum = q.includes('директ') || q.includes('direct');
      const isT1 = q.includes('т1') || q.includes('t1');
      const isTBank = q.includes('тбанк') || q.includes('т-банк') || q.includes('tbank') || q.includes('тиньк');
      const isKontur = q.includes('контур') || q.includes('kontur');
      const isOzon = q.includes('озон') || q.includes('ozon');
      const isSber = q.includes('сбер') || q.includes('sber');
      const isAvito = q.includes('авито') || q.includes('avito');
      const isYandex = q.includes('яндекс') || q.includes('yandex');
      const isVk = q.includes('вк') || q.includes('vk') || q.includes('вконтакт');

      const compLower = item.company.toLowerCase();
      const matchCompany =
        compLower.includes(q) ||
        (isDirectum && compLower.includes('directum')) ||
        (isT1 && (compLower.includes('т1') || compLower.includes('t1'))) ||
        (isTBank && (compLower.includes('т-банк') || compLower.includes('тинькофф') || compLower.includes('tbank'))) ||
        (isKontur && (compLower.includes('контур') || compLower.includes('kontur'))) ||
        (isOzon && compLower.includes('ozon')) ||
        (isSber && compLower.includes('сбер')) ||
        (isAvito && compLower.includes('avito')) ||
        (isYandex && compLower.includes('яндекс')) ||
        (isVk && compLower.includes('vk'));

      const matchTitle = item.title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchTags = item.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      const matchDesc = item.description.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return matchTitle || matchCompany || matchTags || matchDesc;
    }

    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col relative light bg-[#dbe0ea] text-neutral-900 liquid-ambient selection:bg-neutral-950 selection:text-white">
      {/* Soft atmospheric diffused ambient light for frosted glass */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden z-0 select-none">
        {/* Top subtle sheen */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 inset-x-0 h-[360px] bg-gradient-to-b from-white/70 via-white/20 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Ambient diffusion spheres - soft optical glow for Apple Liquid Glass refraction */}
        <div className="absolute -top-[10%] -right-[5%] w-[320px] h-[320px] sm:w-[900px] sm:h-[900px] rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-white/70 via-slate-200/50 to-blue-200/30 blur-[40px] sm:blur-[90px] transform-gpu pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute top-[20%] -left-[10%] w-[300px] h-[300px] sm:w-[850px] sm:h-[850px] rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-slate-300/40 via-zinc-200/30 to-slate-200/35 blur-[40px] sm:blur-[90px] transform-gpu pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="hidden sm:block absolute top-[50%] -right-[6%] w-[600px] h-[600px] sm:w-[800px] sm:h-[800px] rounded-full bg-gradient-to-bl from-zinc-200/40 via-slate-200/25 to-slate-300/25 blur-[90px] transform-gpu pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="hidden sm:block absolute -bottom-[8%] left-[8%] w-[620px] h-[620px] sm:w-[850px] sm:h-[850px] rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-slate-300/30 via-zinc-200/25 to-slate-200/25 blur-[90px] transform-gpu pointer-events-none" />
      </div>

      {/* Content Layer floating on top of ambient canvas */}
      <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col min-h-screen">
        {/* Navbar */}
        <Navbar
          activeTab={activeTab}
          setActiveTab={setActiveTab}
          telegramUser={telegramUser}
          vkUser={vkUser}
          isVk={isVk}
          userProgress={userProgress}
          totalTopicsCount={ROADMAP_TOPICS.length}
          totalQuestionsCount={QUESTIONS.length}
          onOpenSubscribeModal={() => {
            triggerHaptic('medium');
            setIsSubscribeModalOpen(true);
          }}
        />

      {/* Main Container */}
      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-5 sm:py-7">
        {/* TAB 1: INTERNSHIPS FEED */}
        {activeTab === 'internships' && (
          <div className="relative space-y-6">
            {/* VK Mini App Profile Card (When opened inside VK) */}
            {/* Ultra-Compact Sleek Apple Liquid Glass Profile Capsule */}
            {vkUser && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2.5 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-full liquid-glass border border-blue-500/20 shadow-xs transition-all duration-300">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                  {vkUser.photo_100 || vkUser.photo_200 ? (
                    <img
                      src={vkUser.photo_100 || vkUser.photo_200}
                      alt={vkUser.first_name || 'VK'}
                      className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover border border-blue-500/30 shrink-0 shadow-xs"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-xs">
                      VK
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-neutral-900 truncate">
                        {vkUser.first_name} {vkUser.last_name || ''}
                      </span>
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 border border-blue-500/20 shrink-0">
                        VK Mini App
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] text-neutral-500 font-medium truncate">
                      {userProgress.completedTopics.length} тем • {userProgress.completedQuestions.length} вопросов
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    triggerHaptic('medium');
                    setIsSubscribeModalOpen(true);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                  title="Настроить уведомления ВКонтакте"
                >
                  <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span className="sm:hidden text-xs font-semibold">Пуши</span>
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline text-xs font-semibold">Уведомления</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Telegram Mini App Profile Card (When opened inside Telegram) */}
            {telegramUser && !vkUser && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2.5 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-full liquid-glass border border-sky-500/25 shadow-xs transition-all duration-300">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                  {telegramUser.photo_url ? (
                    <img
                      src={telegramUser.photo_url}
                      alt={telegramUser.first_name || 'TG'}
                      className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover border border-sky-500/30 shrink-0 shadow-xs"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-sky-600 to-blue-500 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-xs">
                      {telegramUser.first_name ? telegramUser.first_name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() : 'TG'}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-neutral-900 truncate">
                        {telegramUser.first_name} {telegramUser.last_name || ''}
                      </span>
                      {telegramUser.username && (
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500 font-medium truncate">
                          @{telegramUser.username}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-700 border border-sky-500/20 shrink-0">
                        Telegram Mini App
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] text-neutral-500 font-medium truncate">
                      {userProgress.completedTopics.length} тем • {userProgress.completedQuestions.length} вопросов
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    triggerHaptic('medium');
                    setIsSubscribeModalOpen(true);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-black text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                  title="Настроить уведомления в Telegram"
                >
                  <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                  <span className="sm:hidden text-xs font-semibold">Пуши TG</span>
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline text-xs font-semibold">Уведомления TG</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Ambient typography watermark behind cards - guaranteed single line */}
            <div className="absolute inset-x-0 -top-4 sm:-top-6 h-48 sm:h-96 flex items-center justify-center -z-10 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden select-none opacity-[0.035] blur-[0.5px]">
              <span className="text-4xl sm:text-[120px] md:text-[160px] lg:text-[190px] font-black tracking-widest uppercase select-none leading-none text-slate-800 dark:text-white whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">
                IT&#8209;СТАРТ
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Hero Header - Apple Liquid Glass Minimalist */}
            <div className="relative pt-2 sm:pt-6 pb-2 text-center space-y-2 select-none">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-semibold liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-600 dark:bg-neutral-400" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">IT Start Web • Агрегатор стажировок IT-компаний РФ</span>
                <span className="sm:hidden">IT-Старт • Проверенные IT-стажировки</span>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-sans text-neutral-900 dark:text-white leading-tight">
                Агрегатор IT-стажировок
              </h1>
```
