## <a id="src-components-flashcardstrainer-tsx"></a>31. `src/components/FlashcardsTrainer.tsx`

- **Путь:** `src/components/FlashcardsTrainer.tsx`
- **Назначение:** React-компонент пользовательского интерфейса
- **Объем:** 238 строк (9.6 КБ)

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  RotateCcw,
  CheckCircle2,
  Shuffle,
  Eye,
  HelpCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import type { Question, UserProgress } from '../types';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../lib/telegram';

interface FlashcardsTrainerProps {
  questions: Question[];
  userProgress: UserProgress;
  onMarkLearned: (questionId: string) => void;
  onMarkRepeat: (questionId: string) => void;
}

export const FlashcardsTrainer: React.FC<FlashcardsTrainerProps> = ({
  questions,
  userProgress,
  onMarkLearned,
  onMarkRepeat,
}) => {
  const [deck, setDeck] = useState<Question[]>(questions);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isFlipped, setIsFlipped] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Sync deck when questions filter changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setDeck(questions);
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setIsFlipped(false);
  }, [questions]);

  const currentCard = deck[currentIndex];

  const handleFlip = () => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    setIsFlipped(!isFlipped);
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    if (currentIndex < deck.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex((prev) => prev + 1);
      setIsFlipped(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrev = () => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      setCurrentIndex((prev) => prev - 1);
      setIsFlipped(false);
    }
  };

  const handleShuffle = () => {
    triggerHaptic('medium');
    const shuffled = [...deck].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    setDeck(shuffled);
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setIsFlipped(false);
  };

  const handleLearned = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    triggerHaptic('medium');
    onMarkLearned(currentCard.id);
    confetti({ particleCount: 30, spread: 50 });
    handleNext();
  };

  const handleRepeat = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    triggerHaptic('medium');
    onMarkRepeat(currentCard.id);
    handleNext();
  };

  if (!currentCard || deck.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 text-center rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl transition-all liquid-glass text-neutral-800">
        <HelpCircle className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-3 text-neutral-400" />
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-1 font-sans text-neutral-950 leading-snug">Вопросы не найдены</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-500 leading-relaxed">
          Попробуйте сбросить фильтры направления или ветки в панели выше.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isLearned = userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(currentCard.id);
  const isRepeat = userProgress.repeatQuestions.includes(currentCard.id);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-4">
      {/* Top Controls Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs px-1 text-neutral-600 gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap min-w-0">
          <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-neutral-950">
            Карточка {currentIndex + 1} из {deck.length}
          </span>
          {isLearned && (
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium text-[11px] bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-500/20">
              Изучено ✓
            </span>
          )}
          {isRepeat && (
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium text-[11px] bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-800 border border-amber-500/20">
              На повторение
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleShuffle}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-all active:scale-95 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-700 cursor-pointer font-medium shrink-0"
        >
          <Shuffle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Перемешать</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Flashcard interactive body */}
      <div
        onClick={handleFlip}
        className="relative min-h-[340px] p-4 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl cursor-pointer select-none transition-all flex flex-col justify-between group liquid-glass liquid-glass-interactive overflow-hidden"
      >
        {/* Top Badges */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-4">
          <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-700">
            {currentCard.category}
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-neutral-500">
            Сложность: {currentCard.difficulty}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Card Question or Answer */}
        <div className="my-auto">
          {!isFlipped ? (
            <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider block text-neutral-500">
                Вопрос собеседования:
              </span>
              <h3 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold leading-snug font-sans text-neutral-950 break-words">
                {currentCard.title}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-600 font-normal break-words">
                {currentCard.question}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider block text-emerald-800">
                Развернутый эталонный ответ:
              </span>
              <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed p-4 rounded-2xl liquid-glass-subtle text-neutral-900 break-words">
                {currentCard.answer}
              </p>

              {currentCard.codeSnippet && (
                <pre className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-mono text-neutral-200 overflow-x-auto bg-neutral-950 border-black/10 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm touch-pan-x overscroll-x-contain">
                  <code>{currentCard.codeSnippet}</code>
                </pre>
              )}

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold block text-neutral-700">Ключевые тезисы:</span>
                <ul className="text-xs space-y-1 text-neutral-600">
                  {currentCard.keyTakeaways.map((t, idx) => (
                    <li key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">•</span>
                      <span>{t}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Flip hint at bottom */}
        <div className="pt-4 border-t flex items-center justify-between text-xs border-black/5 dark:border-white/5 text-neutral-500">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            {isFlipped ? 'Нажмите, чтобы вернуться к вопросу' : 'Нажмите, чтобы увидеть ответ'}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[11px] hidden sm:inline opacity-70 font-medium">Клик по карточке переворачивает</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Navigation and Rating Actions */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 pt-1">
        <button
          onClick={handlePrev}
          disabled={currentIndex === 0}
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-4 py-2 sm:py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>Назад</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={handleRepeat}
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-4 py-2 sm:py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-800 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>Повторить</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={handleLearned}
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-4 py-2 sm:py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-black text-white shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
        >
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span className="hidden min-[380px]:inline">Знаю отлично</span>
          <span className="min-[380px]:hidden">Знаю</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={handleNext}
          disabled={currentIndex === deck.length - 1}
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-4 py-2 sm:py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <span>Вперед</span>
          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

## <a id="src-components-internshipmodal-tsx"></a>33. `src/components/InternshipModal.tsx`

- **Путь:** `src/components/InternshipModal.tsx`
- **Назначение:** React-компонент пользовательского интерфейса
- **Объем:** 582 строк (30.0 КБ)

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import {
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
  Circle,
  ExternalLink,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  MapPin,
  Clock,
  Trophy,
  CheckSquare,
  Square,
  Map,
  HelpCircle,
  Bot,
  Globe,
} from 'lucide-react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import type { Internship, Question, RoadmapTopic, UserProgress } from '../types';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../lib/telegram';
import { resolveApplyUrl, resolveChannelHandle, getCompanyMonogram, formatSalary } from '../lib/vacancyUrl';
import { useScrollLock } from '../lib/useScrollLock';

interface InternshipModalProps {
  internship: Internship | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  roadmapTopics: RoadmapTopic[];
  questions: Question[];
  userProgress: UserProgress;
  onToggleTopic: (topicId: string) => void;
  onToggleSubtopic?: (topicId: string, subtopicIndex: number) => void;
  onToggleQuestion: (questionId: string) => void;
}

export const InternshipModal: React.FC<InternshipModalProps> = ({
  internship,
  onClose,
  roadmapTopics,
  questions,
  userProgress,
  onToggleTopic,
  onToggleSubtopic,
  onToggleQuestion,
}) => {
  const [expandedQuestionId, setExpandedQuestionId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Lock background scroll on mobile and desktop while modal is open
  useScrollLock(Boolean(internship));

  // Close on Escape key press
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!internship) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [internship, onClose]);

  if (!internship) return null;

  // Filter relevant roadmap topics matching direction and subtrack
  const relevantTopics = roadmapTopics.filter(
    (t) =>
      t.directionId === internship.directionId &&
      (t.category === 'core' || t.subTrackId === internship.subTrackId)
  );

  // Filter relevant profile questions
  const relevantQuestions = questions.filter(
    (q) =>
      q.directionId === internship.directionId &&
      (q.subTrackId === 'core' || q.subTrackId === internship.subTrackId)
  );

  // Compute readiness score
  const totalItems = relevantTopics.length + relevantQuestions.length;
  const completedTopicsCount = relevantTopics.filter((t) =>
    userProgress.completedTopics.includes(t.id)
  ).length;
  const completedQuestionsCount = relevantQuestions.filter((q) =>
    userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(q.id)
  ).length;
  const totalCompleted = completedTopicsCount + completedQuestionsCount;

  const readinessPercent = totalItems > 0 ? Math.round((totalCompleted / totalItems) * 100) : 0;

  const isSubtopicChecked = (topicId: string, subIdx: number) => {
    const subtopicKey = `${topicId}__sub_${subIdx}`;
    return Boolean(
      userProgress.completedSubtopics?.includes(subtopicKey) ||
      userProgress.completedTopics.includes(topicId)
    );
  };

  const getTopicProgress = (topic: RoadmapTopic) => {
    const total = topic.subtopics.length;
    if (total === 0) {
      const done = userProgress.completedTopics.includes(topic.id);
      return { total: 0, checked: done ? 1 : 0, percent: done ? 100 : 0, isDone: done };
    }
    const checked = topic.subtopics.filter((_, sIdx) => isSubtopicChecked(topic.id, sIdx)).length;
    const percent = Math.round((checked / total) * 100);
    const isDone = checked === total || userProgress.completedTopics.includes(topic.id);
    return { total, checked, percent, isDone };
  };

  const handleToggleTopic = (topicId: string) => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    onToggleTopic(topicId);
    if (!userProgress.completedTopics.includes(topicId) && totalCompleted + 1 === totalItems) {
      confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 70 });
    }
  };

  const handleToggleSubtopic = (topicId: string, subIdx: number) => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    if (onToggleSubtopic) {
      onToggleSubtopic(topicId, subIdx);
    } else {
      onToggleTopic(topicId);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleQuestion = (questionId: string) => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    onToggleQuestion(questionId);
    if (!userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(questionId) && totalCompleted + 1 === totalItems) {
      confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 70 });
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadge = () => {
    if (readinessPercent >= 80) {
      return {
        label: 'Готов к собеседованию! 🔥',
        color: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 border border-emerald-500/20 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/30',
      };
    }
    if (readinessPercent >= 40) {
      return {
        label: 'В активной подготовке 🚀',
        color: 'bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-800 border border-neutral-200/80 dark:bg-white/[0.06] dark:text-neutral-200 dark:border-white/10',
      };
    }
    return {
      label: 'Начальный уровень 📚',
      color: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 border border-amber-500/20 dark:bg-amber-500/15 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30',
    };
  };

  const statusBadge = getStatusBadge();

  return (
    <div
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 pt-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))] pb-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] liquid-modal-overlay overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain touch-pan-y modal-overlay-animation"
      style={{
        paddingTop: 'max(0.75rem, max(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px), var(--vk-safe-area-top, 0px)))',
        paddingBottom: 'max(0.75rem, max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px), var(--vk-safe-area-bottom, 0px)))',
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="relative w-full max-w-3xl rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-8 my-auto sm:my-8 max-h-[92vh] sm:max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col modal-enter-animation liquid-glass-modal text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-100 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Закрыть"
          className="absolute top-3.5 right-3.5 sm:top-5 sm:right-5 min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] p-2.5 rounded-full transition-transform duration-150 z-10 active:scale-95 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-600 hover:text-neutral-950 dark:text-neutral-300 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="shrink-0 pb-4 border-b pr-10 border-black/5 dark:border-white/5">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5 mb-2">
            <div className="w-11 h-11 sm:w-12 sm:h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm sm:text-base shrink-0 overflow-hidden liquid-glass-tile text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-100">
              <span className="relative z-10 select-none tracking-tight">
                {getCompanyMonogram(internship.company)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 flex-wrap">
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-neutral-950 dark:text-white font-sans tracking-tight">
                  {internship.company}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                  <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-70" />
                  {internship.location}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-70" />
                  {internship.format}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-neutral-900 dark:text-white font-sans break-words leading-snug">
                План подготовки: {internship.title}
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200">
              {formatSalary(internship.salary)}
            </span>
            {(() => {
              const verifiedChannel = resolveChannelHandle(internship.sourceChannel, internship.company);
              const cleanChannel = verifiedChannel.replace(/^@/, '');
              const isTg = verifiedChannel.startsWith('@');
              const isWeb = verifiedChannel.includes('.');

              if (isTg) {
                return (
                  <a
                    href={`https://t.me/${cleanChannel}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Bot className="w-3 h-3 text-neutral-500" />
                    <span>Источник: {verifiedChannel}</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5 opacity-60" />
                  </a>
                );
              }

              if (isWeb) {
                const targetUrl = verifiedChannel.startsWith('http') ? verifiedChannel : `https://${verifiedChannel}`;
                return (
                  <a
                    href={targetUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Globe className="w-3 h-3 text-neutral-500" />
                    <span>Источник: {verifiedChannel}</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5 opacity-60" />
                  </a>
                );
              }

              return (
                <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400">
                  Источник: {internship.sourceChannel}
                </span>
              );
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Content */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto py-4 space-y-6 flex-1 pr-1 custom-scroll touch-pan-y overscroll-contain">
          {/* Readiness Progress Bar Card */}
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl liquid-glass-subtle transition-colors">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-2 flex-wrap">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Trophy className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 dark:text-white font-sans">
                  Ваша готовность к этой стажировке:
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${statusBadge.color}`}>
                {statusBadge.label}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-1.5">
              <span className="text-xs text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400">
                Изучено {totalCompleted} из {totalItems} тем и профильных вопросов
              </span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-neutral-900 dark:text-white">{readinessPercent}%</span>
            </div>

            <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/10">
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 bg-neutral-800 dark:bg-neutral-200"
                style={{ width: `${readinessPercent}%` }}
              />
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs mt-2 text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400">
              💡 Отмечайте изученные разделы и вопросы прямо в этом окне — ваш прогресс сохраняется синхронно в базе данных!
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Section 1: Required Roadmap Steps */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 font-sans text-neutral-900 dark:text-white">
                <Map className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400" />
                Этапы роадмапа для вакансии ({completedTopicsCount}/{relevantTopics.length})
              </h3>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {relevantTopics.map((topic) => {
                const { total, checked, percent, isDone } = getTopicProgress(topic);
                return (
                  <div
                    key={topic.id}
                    className={`p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isDone
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/25 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:border-emerald-500/35'
                        : 'liquid-glass-subtle'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 sm:gap-3">
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleTopic(topic.id)}
                          className="mt-0.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-emerald-500 transition-colors shrink-0"
                          title={isDone ? 'Снять отметку' : 'Отметить тему как изученную'}
                        >
                          {isDone ? (
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                          ) : (
                            <Circle className="w-5 h-5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-700 dark:hover:text-neutral-200" />
                          )}
                        </button>
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 dark:text-white font-sans break-words leading-snug">{topic.title}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-200">
                              {topic.category === 'core' ? 'База' : 'Стек'}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-200">
                              {topic.difficulty}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-300 mt-1 leading-relaxed">{topic.description}</p>
                          <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 leading-relaxed">
                            <strong>Совет для интервью:</strong> {topic.interviewTip}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <a
                        href={topic.externalDocUrl}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors shrink-0 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/80 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-200"
                        title="Открыть документацию"
                      >
                        <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </a>
                    </div>

                    {/* Topic Progress Bar */}
                    <div className="rounded-xl p-2.5 my-3 liquid-glass-pill">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] mb-1">
                        <span className="text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400">Прогресс раздела:</span>
                        <span className={`font-semibold ${isDone ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-neutral-900 dark:text-white'}`}>
                          {percent}% ({checked} из {total} подтем)
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-neutral-900/10 dark:bg-white/15">
                        <div
                          className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                            isDone ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-neutral-900 dark:bg-white'
                          }`}
                          style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {topic.subtopics && topic.subtopics.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-black/5 dark:border-white/5">
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400">
                          Ключевые подтемы (отметьте изученные):
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                          {topic.subtopics.map((sub, sIdx) => {
                            const isSubDone = isSubtopicChecked(topic.id, sIdx);
                            return (
                              <button
                                key={sIdx}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleToggleSubtopic(topic.id, sIdx)}
                                className={`flex items-start gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl text-left text-xs transition-colors select-none ${
                                  isSubDone
                                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-500/25 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/35'
                                    : 'liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-700 hover:bg-white/80 dark:text-neutral-300 dark:hover:bg-white/15'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {isSubDone ? (
                                  <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                                ) : (
                                  <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                                )}
                                <span className={isSubDone ? 'line-through opacity-80' : ''}>
                                  {sub}
                                </span>
                              </button>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section 2: Profile Interview Questions */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 text-neutral-900 dark:text-white">
                <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400" />
                Профильные вопросы собеседования ({completedQuestionsCount}/{relevantQuestions.length})
              </h3>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {relevantQuestions.map((q) => {
                const isCompleted = userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(q.id);
                const isExpanded = expandedQuestionId === q.id;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={q.id}
                    className={`rounded-2xl transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isCompleted
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/25 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:border-emerald-500/35'
                        : 'liquid-glass-subtle'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="p-3.5 flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 sm:gap-3">
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleQuestion(q.id)}
                          aria-label={isCompleted ? 'Отметить как неизученный' : 'Отметить как изученный'}
                          className="min-w-[40px] min-h-[40px] -ml-2 -mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400 hover:text-emerald-500 transition-colors shrink-0"
                        >
                          {isCompleted ? (
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                          ) : (
                            <Circle className="w-5 h-5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-700 dark:hover:text-neutral-200" />
                          )}
                        </button>

                        <div className="cursor-pointer flex-1 min-w-0" onClick={() => setExpandedQuestionId(isExpanded ? null : q.id)}>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-1 text-[11px]">
                            <span className="font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-700 dark:bg-white/[0.06] dark:text-neutral-300">
                              {q.category}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400">{q.difficulty}</span>
                          </div>
                          <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 dark:text-white font-sans break-words leading-snug">{q.title}</h4>
                          <p className="text-xs text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 mt-1 break-words leading-relaxed">{q.question}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setExpandedQuestionId(isExpanded ? null : q.id)}
                        aria-label={isExpanded ? 'Свернуть' : 'Развернуть'}
                        className="min-w-[40px] min-h-[40px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-transform duration-150 active:scale-95 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-700 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                      >
                        {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {isExpanded && (
                      <div className="px-4 pb-4 pt-2 border-t space-y-3 border-black/5 dark:border-white/5 liquid-glass-subtle rounded-b-2xl">
                        <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed p-3.5 rounded-xl liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-100 break-words">
                          <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 block mb-1">Эталонный ответ:</span>
                          {q.answer}
                        </div>

                        {q.codeSnippet && (
                          <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-black/10 dark:border-white/10 bg-neutral-950 text-neutral-100 shadow-sm">
                            <div className="px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 border-b border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900">
                              {q.codeLanguage || 'code'}
                            </div>
                            <pre className="p-3 text-xs font-mono text-neutral-200 overflow-x-auto touch-pan-x overscroll-x-contain">
                              <code>{q.codeSnippet}</code>
                            </pre>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300 block">Главные тезисы:</span>
                          <ul className="list-disc list-inside text-xs space-y-1 text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300">
                            {q.keyTakeaways.map((point, idx) => (
                              <li key={idx} className="leading-relaxed">{point}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="shrink-0 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-[max(0.25rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] border-t flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 border-black/5 dark:border-white/5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-initial min-h-[44px] px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-transform duration-150 active:scale-95 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-800 cursor-pointer text-center"
            >
              Закрыть
            </button>

            {(() => {
              const verifiedChannel = resolveChannelHandle(internship.sourceChannel, internship.company);
              const cleanChannel = verifiedChannel.replace(/^@/, '');
              const isTg = verifiedChannel.startsWith('@');
              const isWeb = verifiedChannel.includes('.');

              if (isTg) {
                return (
                  <a
                    href={`https://t.me/${cleanChannel}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-initial min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-transform duration-150 active:scale-95 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200 truncate"
                    title={`Открыть проверенный Telegram-канал ${verifiedChannel}`}
                  >
                    <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400" />
                    <span className="truncate">Канал {verifiedChannel}</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                  </a>
                );
              }

              if (isWeb) {
                const targetUrl = verifiedChannel.startsWith('http') ? verifiedChannel : `https://${verifiedChannel}`;
                return (
                  <a
                    href={targetUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-initial min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-transform duration-150 active:scale-95 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200 truncate"
                    title={`Открыть карьерный сайт ${verifiedChannel}`}
                  >
                    <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400" />
                    <span className="truncate">Сайт {verifiedChannel}</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                  </a>
                );
              }

              return null;
            })()}
          </div>

          {(() => {
            const verifiedApplyUrl = resolveApplyUrl(internship.applyUrl, internship.company, internship.sourceChannel, internship.directionId);
            const isTgPost = verifiedApplyUrl.includes('t.me/');
            return (
              <a
                href={verifiedApplyUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="w-full sm:w-auto min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-5 sm:px-6 py-2.5 rounded-full font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150 bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-black text-white dark:bg-white dark:hover:bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-900 shadow-xs cursor-pointer text-center"
                title={`Подать заявку: ${verifiedApplyUrl}`}
              >
                <span className="sm:hidden truncate">{isTgPost ? 'Пост с вакансией' : `Откликнуться на ${internship.company}`}</span>
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">{isTgPost ? 'Перейти к вакансии в Telegram' : `Подать заявку на сайте ${internship.company}`}</span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              </a>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

## <a id="src-components-navbar-tsx"></a>34. `src/components/Navbar.tsx`

- **Путь:** `src/components/Navbar.tsx`
- **Назначение:** React-компонент пользовательского интерфейса
- **Объем:** 200 строк (9.3 КБ)

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import {
  Briefcase,
  Map,
  HelpCircle,
  Send,
  Bot,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { TelegramUser, UserProgress } from '../types';
import type { VkUser } from '../lib/vkBridge';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../lib/telegram';

interface NavbarProps {
  activeTab: 'internships' | 'roadmaps' | 'questions' | 'telegram';
  setActiveTab: (tab: 'internships' | 'roadmaps' | 'questions' | 'telegram') => void;
  telegramUser?: TelegramUser | null;
  vkUser?: VkUser | null;
  isVk?: boolean;
  userProgress?: UserProgress;
  totalTopicsCount?: number;
  totalQuestionsCount?: number;
  onOpenSubscribeModal: () => void;
  theme?: 'dark' | 'light';
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
}

export const Navbar: React.FC<NavbarProps> = ({
  activeTab,
  setActiveTab,
  telegramUser,
  vkUser,
  isVk,
  onOpenSubscribeModal,
}) => {
  const handleTabClick = (tab: 'internships' | 'roadmaps' | 'questions' | 'telegram') => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    setActiveTab(tab);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const navTabs = [
    { id: 'internships' as const, label: 'Стажировки', icon: Briefcase },
    { id: 'roadmaps' as const, label: 'Роадмапы', icon: Map },
    { id: 'questions' as const, label: 'Тренажёр', icon: HelpCircle },
    { id: 'telegram' as const, label: 'Парсер', icon: Send },
  ];

  return (
    <header
      className={`sticky top-2 sm:top-4 z-50 flex items-center justify-center w-full pointer-events-none transition-all duration-200 ${
        (isVk || vkUser)
          ? 'pl-2 pr-[max(84px,var(--vk-safe-area-right,0px))] sm:pl-4 sm:pr-[max(84px,var(--vk-safe-area-right,0px))]'
          : 'px-2 sm:px-4'
      }`}
      style={{
        paddingTop: 'max(0px, var(--vk-safe-area-top, 0px), env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px))',
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-1 sm:gap-2 p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-full transition-transform duration-300 max-w-5xl w-full sm:w-auto liquid-glass-nav"
      >
        {/* Brand / Logo (Minimalist & Clean) */}
        <div
          onClick={() => handleTabClick('internships')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-1.5 pr-1 sm:pr-2.5 py-1 cursor-pointer select-none group shrink-0"
          title="IT-Старт Главная"
        >
          <div
            className="w-7 h-7 sm:w-8 sm:h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs tracking-tight transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105 shadow-xs
              bg-neutral-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-black"
          >
            IT
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold tracking-tight hidden sm:inline text-neutral-900 dark:text-white">
            IT-Старт
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Subtle Divider */}
        <div className="h-4 w-px shrink-0 mx-0.5 bg-black/10 dark:bg-white/10" />

        {/* Center Navigation Tabs - Responsive Dynamic Island (Active label + sleek compact icons on mobile) */}
        <nav className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-0.5 px-0.5 min-w-0">
          {navTabs.map((tab) => {
            const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => handleTabClick(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white shadow-xs dark:bg-white dark:text-black'
                    : 'text-neutral-700 hover:text-neutral-950 hover:bg-white/40 dark:text-neutral-300 dark:hover:text-white dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                }`}
                title={tab.label}
              >
                <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                <span className={isActive ? 'inline' : 'hidden sm:inline'}>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        {/* Subtle Divider */}

                title={`VK: ${vkUser.first_name || ''} ${vkUser.last_name || ''} (ID: ${vkUser.id})`}
              >

                  <div className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center">

                <span className="text-xs font-semibold hidden md:inline truncate max-w-[100px]">
                  {vkUser.first_name || 'VK'}

                  Mini App

              <button

                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 rounded-full font-semibold text-xs transition-transform duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-xs shrink-0 bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-black text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-900 cursor-pointer"
                title={`VK: ${vkUser.first_name || ''} • Уведомления`}
              >
                <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                title={`Telegram: ${telegramUser.first_name || ''} (@${telegramUser.username || ''}) (ID: ${telegramUser.id})`}

                    TG

                </span>

              <button
                onClick={() => {

                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 rounded-full font-semibold text-xs transition-transform duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-xs shrink-0 bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-black text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-900 cursor-pointer"
                title={`Telegram: ${telegramUser.first_name || ''} • Уведомления`}
              >

          ) : (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                triggerHaptic('medium');
                onOpenSubscribeModal();

              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-semibold text-xs transition-transform duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-xs shrink-0 bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-black text-white cursor-pointer"
              title="Боты и уведомления"
            >
              <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Боты</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
};
```

## <a id="src-components-questionsviewer-tsx"></a>35. `src/components/QuestionsViewer.tsx`

- **Путь:** `src/components/QuestionsViewer.tsx`
- **Назначение:** React-компонент пользовательского интерфейса
- **Объем:** 537 строк (26.7 КБ)

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  CheckCircle2,
  Circle,
  RotateCcw,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  LayoutList,
  Layers,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Code,
  PenTool,
  Send,
  Eye,
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import type { DirectionId, Question, SubTrackId, UserProgress } from '../types';
import { DIRECTIONS } from '../data/directions';
import { FlashcardsTrainer } from './FlashcardsTrainer';
import { SelfCheckTrainer } from './SelfCheckTrainer';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../lib/telegram';

interface QuestionsViewerProps {
  questions: Question[];
  userProgress: UserProgress;
  onToggleQuestion: (questionId: string) => void;
  onMarkRepeat: (questionId: string) => void;
  onMarkLearned: (questionId: string) => void;
}

export const QuestionsViewer: React.FC<QuestionsViewerProps> = ({
  questions,
  userProgress,
  onToggleQuestion,
  onMarkRepeat,
  onMarkLearned,
}) => {
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'accordion' | 'self_check' | 'flashcards'>('self_check');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedDirection, setSelectedDirection] = useState<DirectionId | 'all'>('all');
  const [selectedSubTrack, setSelectedSubTrack] = useState<SubTrackId | 'all'>('all');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'all' | 'repeat' | 'completed'>('all');
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [inlineAnswers, setInlineAnswers] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [inlineChecked, setInlineChecked] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  // Filter questions
  const filteredQuestions = questions.filter((q) => {
    // Direction filter
    if (selectedDirection !== 'all' && q.directionId !== selectedDirection) {
      return false;
    }

    // Sub-track filter
    if (
      selectedSubTrack !== 'all' &&
      q.subTrackId !== selectedSubTrack &&
      q.subTrackId !== 'core'
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    // Status filter
    if (statusFilter === 'completed' && !userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(q.id)) {
      return false;
    }
    if (statusFilter === 'repeat' && !userProgress.repeatQuestions.includes(q.id)) {
      return false;
    }

    // Search query
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const qLower = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const matchTitle = q.title.toLowerCase().includes(qLower);
      const matchQuestion = q.question.toLowerCase().includes(qLower);
      const matchAnswer = q.answer.toLowerCase().includes(qLower);
      const matchCategory = q.category.toLowerCase().includes(qLower);
      return matchTitle || matchQuestion || matchAnswer || matchCategory;
    }

    return true;
  });

  const completedCount = questions.filter((q) =>
    userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(q.id)
  ).length;

  const repeatCount = questions.filter((q) =>
    userProgress.repeatQuestions.includes(q.id)
  ).length;

  const handleToggle = (id: string) => {
    triggerHaptic('selection');
    onToggleQuestion(id);
    if (!userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(id)) {
      confetti({ particleCount: 40, spread: 50 });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Banner & Stats - Apple Minimalist Liquid Glass */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-all duration-300 liquid-glass">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 flex-wrap">
            <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2 font-sans text-neutral-900 dark:text-white">
              Тренажёр вопросов к собеседованию
            </h2>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-200">
              {questions.length} вопросов
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-300">
            Реальные вопросы с интервью стажёров: пишите ответ, сверяйте с эталоном и тренируйте насмотренность.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* View Mode Switcher: 3 Modes (Segmented Capsule Control) */}
        <div className="flex items-center p-1 rounded-full text-xs transition-colors liquid-glass-subtle max-w-full overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar shrink-0 touch-pan-x overscroll-x-contain">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              triggerHaptic('selection');
              setViewMode('self_check');
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-semibold transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
              viewMode === 'self_check'
                ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-950 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <PenTool className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Самопроверка</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              triggerHaptic('selection');
              setViewMode('accordion');
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-semibold transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
              viewMode === 'accordion'
                ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-950 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <LayoutList className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Список</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              triggerHaptic('selection');
              setViewMode('flashcards');
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-semibold transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
              viewMode === 'flashcards'
                ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-950 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Карточки</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters Bar */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3.5 transition-all duration-300 liquid-glass">
        {/* Row 1: Search + Status tabs */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative w-full sm:flex-1 min-w-0">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-neutral-400 dark:text-neutral-500" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Поиск по вопросу, ключевому слову или коду..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all focus:outline-none liquid-glass-subtle focus:bg-white/50 text-neutral-900 placeholder:text-neutral-500 dark:text-white dark:placeholder:text-neutral-400"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar shrink-0 touch-pan-x overscroll-x-contain pb-0.5 sm:pb-0">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('all')}
              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
                statusFilter === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950 shadow-sm'
                  : 'liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/80 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-200'
              }`}
            >
              Все ({questions.length})
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('repeat')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
                statusFilter === 'repeat'
                  ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/80 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400'
              }`}
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Повторить ({repeatCount})</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('completed')}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
                statusFilter === 'completed'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/80 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Изучено ({completedCount})</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Row 2: Directions pills */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pt-1 touch-pan-x overscroll-x-contain">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setSelectedDirection('all');
              setSelectedSubTrack('all');
            }}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
              selectedDirection === 'all'
                ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-700'
            }`}
          >
            Все направления
          </button>
          {DIRECTIONS.map((dir) => (
            <button
              key={dir.id}
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedDirection(dir.id);
                setSelectedSubTrack('all');
              }}
              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
                selectedDirection === dir.id
                  ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-700'
              }`}
            >
              {dir.title.split('-')[0]}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Row 3: Sub-tracks pills if direction chosen */}
        {selectedDirection !== 'all' && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pt-1.5 border-t border-black/5 dark:border-white/5 touch-pan-x overscroll-x-contain">
            <button
              onClick={() => setSelectedSubTrack('all')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
                selectedSubTrack === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-700'
              }`}
            >
              Все ветки
            </button>
            {DIRECTIONS.find((d) => d.id === selectedDirection)?.subTracks.map((st) => (
              <button
                key={st.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedSubTrack(st.id)}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 ${
                  selectedSubTrack === st.id
                    ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-700'
                }`}
              >
                {st.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Main Content: Self-Check Trainer, Flashcards, or Accordion */}
      {viewMode === 'self_check' ? (
        <SelfCheckTrainer
          questions={filteredQuestions}
          userProgress={userProgress}
          userAnswers={inlineAnswers}
          submittedQuestions={inlineChecked}
          onAnswerChange={(qid, ans) => setInlineAnswers((prev) => ({ ...prev, [qid]: ans }))}
          onSubmitQuestion={(qid) => setInlineChecked((prev) => ({ ...prev, [qid]: true }))}
          onResetQuestion={(qid) => setInlineChecked((prev) => ({ ...prev, [qid]: false }))}
          onMarkLearned={onMarkLearned}
          onMarkRepeat={onMarkRepeat}
        />
      ) : viewMode === 'flashcards' ? (
        <FlashcardsTrainer
          questions={filteredQuestions}
          userProgress={userProgress}
          onMarkLearned={onMarkLearned}
          onMarkRepeat={onMarkRepeat}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {filteredQuestions.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl transition-colors liquid-glass">
              <SlidersHorizontal className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 text-neutral-400 dark:text-neutral-500" />
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold mb-1 font-sans text-neutral-900 dark:text-white leading-snug">Ничего не найдено</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
                Попробуйте изменить поисковый запрос или сбросить фильтры.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredQuestions.map((q) => {
              const isCompleted = userProgress.completedQuestions.includes(q.id);
              const isRepeat = userProgress.repeatQuestions.includes(q.id);
              const isExpanded = expandedId === q.id;
              const isChecked = !!inlineChecked[q.id];
              const userAnswer = inlineAnswers[q.id] || '';

              return (
                <div
                  key={q.id}
                  className={`rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl border transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isCompleted
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/25 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:border-emerald-500/35 liquid-glass-interactive'
                      : isRepeat
                      ? 'bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/25 dark:bg-amber-500/15 dark:border-amber-500/35 liquid-glass-interactive'
                      : 'liquid-glass liquid-glass-interactive'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="p-5 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 flex-1">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleToggle(q.id)}
                        className="mt-0.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-emerald-500 transition-colors shrink-0"
                        title={isCompleted ? 'Отметить как неизученное' : 'Отметить как изученное'}
                      >
                        {isCompleted ? (
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                        ) : (
                          <Circle className="w-5 h-5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-700 dark:hover:text-neutral-200" />
                        )}
                      </button>

                      <div
                        className="cursor-pointer flex-1"
                        onClick={() => setExpandedId(isExpanded ? null : q.id)}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-1.5">
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-200">
                            {q.category}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400">{q.difficulty}</span>
                          {isRepeat && (
                            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border
                              bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 border-amber-500/30
                              dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/40"
                            >
                              В повторении
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold transition-colors font-sans leading-snug
                          text-neutral-900 group-hover:text-neutral-700
                          dark:text-white dark:group-hover:text-neutral-200"
                        >
                          {q.title}
                        </h3>

                        <p className="text-xs mt-1.5 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400">
                          {q.question}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExpandedId(isExpanded ? null : q.id)}
                      className="p-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 shrink-0 liquid-glass-pill hover:bg-white/50 text-neutral-700 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {isExpanded && (
                    <div className="px-5 pb-5 pt-3 border-t rounded-b-3xl space-y-4 border-black/5 dark:border-white/5 liquid-glass-subtle">
                      {/* Full Question text */}
                      <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl liquid-glass-pill text-xs leading-relaxed text-neutral-900">
                        <strong className="block mb-1 text-neutral-950 font-bold">Вопрос интервьюера:</strong>
                        {q.question}
                      </div>

                      {/* Code Snippet if present */}
                      {q.codeSnippet && (
                        <div className="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-black/10 dark:border-white/10 bg-neutral-950 text-neutral-100 shadow-sm">
                          <div className="px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono border-b border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-400">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <Code className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-400" />
                              {q.codeLanguage || 'code'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <pre className="p-3.5 text-xs font-mono text-neutral-200 overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed">
                            <code>{q.codeSnippet}</code>
                          </pre>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Interactive Self-Check Field */}
                      {!isChecked ? (
                        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl liquid-glass-pill space-y-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-neutral-900">
                              <PenTool className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-600" />
                              Самопроверка: попробуйте ответить самостоятельно
                            </span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setInlineChecked((prev) => ({ ...prev, [q.id]: true }));
                              }}
                              className="text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 text-neutral-600 hover:text-neutral-950 transition-colors"
                            >
                              <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>Показать ответ сразу</span>
                            </button>
                          </div>

                          <textarea
                            value={userAnswer}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const val = e.target.value;
                              setInlineAnswers((prev) => ({ ...prev, [q.id]: val }));
                            }}
                            rows={2}
                            placeholder="Введите ваш ответ для сверки..."
                            className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all focus:outline-none liquid-glass-subtle bg-white/40 focus:bg-white/70 text-neutral-950 placeholder:text-neutral-500 shadow-xs"
                          />

                          <div className="flex justify-end">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                triggerHaptic('medium');
                                setInlineChecked((prev) => ({ ...prev, [q.id]: true }));
                              }}
                              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-xs bg-neutral-900 text-white hover:bg-black cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Сверить с эталоном</span>
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-3">
                          {userAnswer.trim() && (
                            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl liquid-glass-pill text-xs shadow-xs">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                                <strong className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-600 font-bold">Ваш ответ:</strong>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => setInlineChecked((prev) => ({ ...prev, [q.id]: false }))}
                                  className="text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 text-neutral-600 hover:text-black transition-colors"
                                >
                                  <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  Изменить
                                </button>
                              </div>
                              <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-neutral-900 font-medium">{userAnswer}</p>
                            </div>
                          )}

                          {/* Detailed Answer */}
                          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/25 bg-emerald-500/10 text-neutral-900 text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed shadow-xs">
                            <strong className="block mb-1.5 font-bold text-emerald-800">Развернутый эталонный ответ:</strong>
                            {q.answer}
                          </div>

                          {/* Key Takeaways */}
                          <div className="space-y-1.5">
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block text-neutral-700">
                              Что важно запомнить:
                            </span>
                            <ul className="text-xs space-y-1 list-disc list-inside text-neutral-700">
                              {q.keyTakeaways.map((point, idx) => (
                                <li key={idx}>{point}</li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Card Action Buttons */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-black/5 dark:border-white/5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            triggerHaptic('medium');
                            onMarkRepeat(q.id);
                          }}
                          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-xs cursor-pointer ${
                            isRepeat
                              ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white'
                              : 'liquid-glass-pill text-amber-800 hover:bg-amber-500/15'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>{isRepeat ? 'В повторении' : 'Повторить позже'}</span>
                        </button>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggle(q.id)}
                          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-xs cursor-pointer ${
                            isCompleted
                              ? 'bg-neutral-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-neutral-950'
                              : 'liquid-glass-pill text-neutral-800 hover:bg-white/50 dark:text-neutral-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{isCompleted ? 'Изучено ✓' : 'Отметить изученным'}</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```
