```typescript
    question: 'В каком порядке выполнятся console.log в данном коде и почему?',
    category: 'JavaScript Core',
    difficulty: 'Junior',
    answer: 'Сначала выполняется синхронный код (выведет 1 и 4). Затем Call Stack освобождается, и движок опустошает очередь МИКРОЗАДАЧ (Microtasks Queue): выполняются колбэки промисов (выведет 3). И только после этого движок переходит к очереди МАКРОЗАДАЧ (Macrotasks Queue / Task Queue): выполняется setTimeout (выведет 2). Итог: 1, 4, 3, 2.',
    codeSnippet: `console.log(1);
setTimeout(() => console.log(2), 0);
Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log(3));
console.log(4);`,
    codeLanguage: 'javascript',
    keyTakeaways: [
      'Call Stack всегда выполняется до конца синхронно',
      'Микрозадачи (Promise, queueMicrotask) имеют приоритет над макрозадачами (setTimeout, setInterval, setImmediate)',
      'Очередь микрозадач вычищается полностью между макрозадачами',
    ],
  },

    question: 'Что выведет данный цикл и как исправить проблему двумя способами?',
    category: 'JavaScript Core',
    difficulty: 'Junior',
    answer: 'Выведет три раза число 3 с задержкой в 100 мс! Переменная var имеет функциональную область видимости, поэтому создается одна переменная i на весь цикл. К моменту срабатывания таймеров цикл уже завершился и i равно 3. Исправление 1: заменить var на let (блочная область видимости, для каждой итерации создается отдельная переменная). Исправление 2: создать функцию-обертку (IIFE) или передать i аргументом.',
    codeSnippet: `for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  setTimeout(() => console.log(i), 100);
}

  setTimeout(() => console.log(i), 100); // 0, 1, 2
}`,

    ],

    answer: 'interface предназначен исключительно для описания формы объектов и классов.     codeSnippet: `// Declaration merging (работает только с interface):

type ID = string | number;`,

    keyTakeaways: [

    category: 'React Core',

    answer: 'Virtual DOM — это легковесное представление реального DOM в виде дерева JS-объектов. При изменении состояния React строит новое виртуальное дерево, сравнивает его со старым (Reconciliation / Diffing) и точечно вносит минимальные изменения в реальный DOM. Свойство key служит уникальным идентификатором элемента между рендерами. Если использовать индекс массива, то при удалении или вставке в начало все последующие элементы изменят свои индексы, что приведет к лишним перерисовкам и сбою внутреннего состояния дочерних компонентов.',

    category: 'JavaScript Core',
    difficulty: 'Junior',
    answer: 'В JS наследование основано на прототипах. Каждый объект имеет внутреннюю ссылку [[Prototype]] (доступную через __proto__ или Object.getPrototypeOf()). Если свойство не найдено в объекте, поиск идет вверх по цепочке прототипов вплоть до Object.prototype, а затем null. Обычный объект {} наследует методы toString, hasOwnProperty, constructor из Object.prototype. Создание Object.create(null) порождает «чистый» объект вообще без прототипа ([[Prototype]]: null). Это гарантирует, что в нем нет встроенных ключей, и защищает от атак Prototype Pollution и случайных коллизий ключей (например, если в словарь положат ключ "toString" или "__proto__").',
    codeSnippet: `const dict = Object.create(null);
dict['hasOwnProperty'] = 'мое значение';

// Безопасно, не ломает цепочку прототипов!
console.log(dict.toString); // undefined (нет встроенных методов)
console.log(Object.getPrototypeOf(dict)); // null`,
    codeLanguage: 'javascript',
    keyTakeaways: [
      'prototype — свойство функции-конструктора, __proto__ — ссылка на прототип у созданного экземпляра',
      'Object.create(null) создает чистые хэш-мапы без унаследованных методов Object.prototype',
    ],

Retain Cycle (циклическая ссылка) возникает, когда два объекта сильно ссылаются друг на друга, или когда замыкание захватывает self по сильной ссылке, а self удерживает это замыкание. weak создает слабую ссылку, не увеличивающую счетчик; при деаллокации объекта weak-ссылка автоматически становится nil (всегда Optional). unowned также не увеличивает счетчик, но ожидает, что объект никогда не станет nil (если объект уничтожен, обращение вызовет краш).',

            self.updateUI()
        }
    }
}`,

        self.page = page
        self.username_input = page.locator('#username')
        self.password_input = page.locator('#password')
        self.submit_btn = page.locator('button[type="submit"]')

    async def login(self, user, pwd):
        await self.username_input.fill(user)
        await self.password_input.fill(pwd)
        await self.submit_btn.click()

# Чистый автотест:
async def test_successful_login(page):
    login_page = LoginPage(page)
    await login_page.login("timur", "secret123")
    assert await page.is_visible('.dashboard')`,

      'Упрощается масштабирование и переиспользование шагов тестирования',
    ],
  },
```

## <a id="src-data-roadmaps-ts"></a>44. `src/data/roadmaps.ts`

## <a id="src-index-css"></a>46. `src/index.css`

- **Путь:** `src/index.css`

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));
@custom-variant light (&:where(.light, .light *));

@layer base {
  :root {
    --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  }

  /* Apple Serene Titanium / Smoky Pearl Canvas */
  html, body {
    background-color: #ccd3e0;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    overscroll-behavior-y: none;
  }

  body {
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    line-height: 1.5;
    min-height: 100dvh;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    background-color: #ccd3e0;
  }

  /* Apple Fluid micro-interactions & touch optimization */
  button, a, [role="button"] {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }

  /* Prevent automatic iOS Safari zoom when focusing inputs */
  @media (max-width: 768px), (pointer: coarse) {
    input, textarea, select {
      font-size: 16px;
    }
  }
}

/* Atmospheric Serene Pearl-Gray Minimalist Ambient Canvas */
.liquid-ambient-light,
.liquid-ambient-dark,
.liquid-ambient {
  background-color: #dbe0ea;
  background-image: 
    radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 60% at 50% -5%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) 0%, transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 90% 20%, rgba(210, 220, 235, 0.5) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 10% 50%, rgba(220, 226, 238, 0.5) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(245, 248, 255, 0.75) 0%, transparent 70%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
}

/* Hardware-accelerated modal scale & fade animations (composite-only properties) */
@keyframes modalScaleIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.96) translateZ(0);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateZ(0);
  }
}

@keyframes overlayFadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.modal-enter-animation {
  animation: modalScaleIn 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  transform: translateZ(0);
  transform-origin: center center;
}

.modal-overlay-animation {
  animation: overlayFadeIn 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
  will-change: opacity;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .modal-enter-animation,
  .modal-overlay-animation,
  .liquid-glass-interactive {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* Modal Dimming Overlay (desktop: subtle blur, mobile: lightweight solid overlay) */
.liquid-modal-overlay {
  background-color: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.45);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

/* Modal Dialog Window Surface */
.liquid-glass-modal {
  position: relative;
  backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(130%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(130%);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88) 0%, rgba(246, 248, 252, 0.82) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.50);
  box-shadow: 
    0 25px 50px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
  transform: translateZ(0);
  touch-action: pan-y;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

.dark .liquid-glass-modal {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.90) 0%, rgba(18, 22, 30, 0.86) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  box-shadow: 
    0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.60),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30);
}

/* Eliminate nested backdrop-filter overdraw inside all modal windows */
.liquid-glass-modal .liquid-glass,
.liquid-glass-modal .liquid-glass-subtle,
.liquid-glass-modal .liquid-glass-pill,
.liquid-glass-modal .liquid-glass-tile {
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

/* Minimalist Liquid Matte Frosted Glass Main Surface */
.liquid-glass {
  position: relative;
  backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(130%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(130%);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  box-shadow: 
    0 10px 30px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
  contain: layout style;
}

.liquid-glass-interactive {
  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.2s ease;
  will-change: transform;
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .liquid-glass-interactive:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40);
    box-shadow: 
      0 14px 34px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07),
      0 4px 12px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
  }
}

.liquid-glass-interactive:active {
  transform: scale(0.99);
}

/* Liquid Matte Glass Subtle Surface (Inner cards, steps, widgets) */
.liquid-glass-subtle {
  backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(125%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(125%);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
}

/* Liquid Matte Glass Pill (Tags, filter chips, buttons) */
.liquid-glass-pill {
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(125%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(125%);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
}

/* Floating Navigation Glass Bar - dense frosted milk glass */
.liquid-glass-nav {
  backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(140%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(140%);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) 0%, rgba(246, 248, 252, 0.88) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  box-shadow: 
    0 10px 30px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08),
    0 2px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03);
}

/* App Squircle Tile (Soft matte frosted monochrome squircle) */
.liquid-glass-tile {
  position: relative;
  backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(125%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(125%);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  box-shadow: 
    0 4px 14px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04),
    0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
}

/* Dark mode glass adaptations */
.dark .liquid-glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.40);
}

.dark .liquid-glass-subtle {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

}

.dark .liquid-glass-nav {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.92) 0%, rgba(18, 22, 30, 0.88) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);

}

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);

  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30);

/* Legacy aliases for backward compatibility */
.glass-panel {
  backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(130%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(130%);
}

.glass-pill {
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(125%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(125%);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Mobile Performance Optimizations (Zero nested blur overdraw, lightweight GPU compositor)
   Relieves mobile WebKit / Android Chrome GPU from 3-4 nested gaussian blur passes
   ========================================================================== */
@media (max-width: 768px), (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
  /* Prevent iOS Safari / Android scroll repaint caused by background-attachment: fixed */
  .liquid-ambient-light,
  .liquid-ambient-dark,
  .liquid-ambient {
    background-attachment: scroll !important;
  }

  /* Remove heavy backdrop-blur on modal overlays completely to avoid nested GPU blur shaders */
  .liquid-modal-overlay {
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65) !important;
  }

  /* Gentle frosted Apple Liquid Glass aesthetics on mobile (translucent frosted matte) */
  .liquid-glass-modal {

  }

  .dark .liquid-glass {

  .liquid-glass-subtle {

  }

  .liquid-glass-pill {

  }

  .liquid-glass-nav {
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%);

  /* Eliminate nested blur inside cards on mobile */
  .liquid-glass .liquid-glass-pill,

  html.modal-open main .liquid-glass,
```

- **Путь:** `src/lib/storage.ts`
- **Назначение:** Утилиты интеграции (Supabase, Telegram, VK, URL)
- **Объем:** 95 строк (3.1 КБ)

```typescript
import type { Internship, TelegramSubscription, UserProgress } from '../types';

const PROGRESS_STORAGE_KEY = 'it_start_user_progress';
const SUBSCRIPTION_STORAGE_KEY = 'it_start_local_subscription';
const INTERNSHIPS_STORAGE_KEY = 'it_start_cached_internships';
const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'it_start_theme';

export function getLocalTheme(): 'dark' | 'light' {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'dark';
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw === 'light' || raw === 'dark') return raw;
    return 'dark';
  } catch {
    return 'dark';
  }
}

export function saveLocalTheme(theme: 'dark' | 'light'): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to save theme to localStorage:', e);
  }
}

export function getLocalProgress(): UserProgress {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return { completedTopics: [], completedSubtopics: [], completedQuestions: [], repeatQuestions: [] };
  }
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PROGRESS_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return { completedTopics: [], completedSubtopics: [], completedQuestions: [], repeatQuestions: [] };
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return {
      completedTopics: Array.isArray(parsed.completedTopics) ? parsed.completedTopics : [],
      completedSubtopics: Array.isArray(parsed.completedSubtopics) ? parsed.completedSubtopics : [],
      completedQuestions: Array.isArray(parsed.completedQuestions) ? parsed.completedQuestions : [],
      repeatQuestions: Array.isArray(parsed.repeatQuestions) ? parsed.repeatQuestions : [],
    };
  } catch {
    return { completedTopics: [], completedSubtopics: [], completedQuestions: [], repeatQuestions: [] };
  }
}

export function saveLocalProgress(progress: UserProgress): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PROGRESS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(progress));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to save progress to localStorage:', e);
  }
}

export function getLocalSubscription(): TelegramSubscription | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SUBSCRIPTION_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function saveLocalSubscription(sub: TelegramSubscription): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SUBSCRIPTION_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(sub));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to save subscription to localStorage:', e);
  }
}

export function getCachedInternships(): Internship[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(INTERNSHIPS_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function saveCachedInternships(items: Internship[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(INTERNSHIPS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to cache internships in localStorage:', e);
  }
}
```

- **Назначение:** Утилиты интеграции (Supabase, Telegram, VK, URL)
- **Объем:** 320 строк (10.4 КБ)

```typescript
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type { Internship, TelegramSubscription, UserProgress } from '../types';
import { resolveApplyUrl, resolveChannelHandle, formatSalary, isStrictVacancyPost } from './vacancyUrl';

export const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://pmgsymacvhzsixbpndsn.supabase.co';
export const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY =
  'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InBtZ3N5bWFjdmh6c2l4YnBuZHNuIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTIwNDA1OTEsImV4cCI6MjEwNzYxNjU5MX0.J3LSRV4pYTogH52y1maMV8NZ1J9s72WU2ydtyQhWWr4';

export const TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME = 'IT_start_izh_bot';
export const TELEGRAM_BOT_URL = `https://t.me/${TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME}`;
export const GITHUB_PAGES_URL = 'https://oioiqp.github.io/it-start/';

const quickFetch: typeof fetch = (input, init) => {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 1200);
  if (init?.signal) {
    init.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => controller.abort(), { once: true });
  }
  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal: controller.signal }).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
};

export const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
  global: { fetch: quickFetch },
});

// In-memory fallback stores when Supabase is unreachable (offline / DNS issues / local vitest environment)
const isTestEnv =
  typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' &&
  Boolean((globalThis as any).process?.env?.VITEST || (globalThis as any).process?.env?.NODE_ENV === 'test');
let isSupabaseOffline = isTestEnv;
const inMemoryInternships: Map<string, Internship> = new Map();
const inMemorySubscriptions: Map<string, TelegramSubscription> = new Map();
const inMemoryUserProgress: Map<string, UserProgress> = new Map();

/**
 * Fetch internships from Supabase table `public.internships`
 */
export async function fetchInternshipsFromSupabase(): Promise<Internship[] | null> {
  if (isSupabaseOffline) {
    return inMemoryInternships.size > 0 ? Array.from(inMemoryInternships.values()) : null;
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('internships')
      .select('*')
      .order('published_at', { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase fetch internships error, fallback will be used:', error.message);
      isSupabaseOffline = true;
      if (inMemoryInternships.size > 0) {
        return Array.from(inMemoryInternships.values());
      }
      return null;
    }

    if (data && data.length > 0) {
      const validRows = data.filter((item: any) =>
        isStrictVacancyPost(item.title || '', item.description || '')
      );
      const items = validRows.map((item: any) => {
        const parseArray = (val: any, fallback: string[]): string[] => {
          if (Array.isArray(val)) return val;
          if (typeof val === 'string') {
            try {
              if (val.startsWith('[')) return JSON.parse(val);
              return val.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            } catch {
              return [val];
            }
          }
          return fallback;
        };

        const defaultRequirements = [
          `Знание основ стека ${(item.sub_track || item.sub_track_id || '').toUpperCase()}`,
          'Понимание алгоритмов и структур данных',
          'Опыт работы с Git и желание развиваться',
        ];

        const defaultResponsibilities = [
          'Разработка и поддержка сервисных модулей',
          'Участие в код-ревью и командных синка',
        ];

        const directionId = item.direction || item.direction_id || 'backend';
        const subTrackId = item.sub_track || item.sub_track_id || 'python';

        return {
          id: String(item.id),
          title: item.title,
          company: item.company,
          companyLogo: item.company_logo || '',
          location: item.city || item.location || 'Москва / Удаленно',
          format: item.format || 'Удаленно',
          salary: formatSalary(item.salary),
          directionId,
          subTrackId,
          tags: parseArray(item.tags, [(item.sub_track || 'Junior').toUpperCase()]),
          description: item.description || '',
          requirements: parseArray(item.requirements, defaultRequirements),
          responsibilities: parseArray(item.responsibilities, defaultResponsibilities),
          sourceChannel: resolveChannelHandle(item.source_name || item.source_channel, item.company),
          sourceType: (item.source_type || 'telegram') as 'telegram' | 'portal',
          applyUrl: resolveApplyUrl(item.source_url || item.apply_url, item.company, item.source_name || item.source_channel, directionId),
          publishedAt: item.published_at || new Date().toISOString(),
          isHot: Boolean(item.is_hot),
        };
      });

      items.forEach((item: Internship) => inMemoryInternships.set(item.id, item));
      return items;
    }

    if (inMemoryInternships.size > 0) {
      return Array.from(inMemoryInternships.values());
    }

    return [];
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase query exception, using in-memory store:', err);
    isSupabaseOffline = true;
    if (inMemoryInternships.size > 0) {
      return Array.from(inMemoryInternships.values());
    }
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Seed initial internships if table is empty
 */
export async function seedInternshipsToSupabase(seedData: Internship[]): Promise<boolean> {
  // Always update in-memory store
  seedData.forEach((item) => inMemoryInternships.set(item.id, item));

  if (isSupabaseOffline) return true;

  try {
    const rows = seedData.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      title: item.title,
      company: item.company,
      direction: item.directionId,
      sub_track: item.subTrackId,
      format: item.format,
      city: item.location,
      salary: item.salary,
      source_type: item.sourceType,
      source_name: item.sourceChannel,
      source_url: item.applyUrl,
      description: item.description,
      tags: item.tags,
      published_at: item.publishedAt,
    }));

    const { error } = await supabase.from('internships').upsert(rows, { onConflict: 'id' });
    if (error) {
      console.warn('Seed internships warning (may already exist or RLS):', error.message);
      isSupabaseOffline = true;
      return true;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error during seeding, in-memory used:', err);
    isSupabaseOffline = true;
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Add a new internship to Supabase
 */
export async function addInternshipToSupabase(item: Internship): Promise<boolean> {
  inMemoryInternships.set(item.id, item);

  if (isSupabaseOffline) return true;

  try {
    const row = {
      id: item.id,
      title: item.title,
      company: item.company,
      direction: item.directionId,
      sub_track: item.subTrackId,
      format: item.format,
      city: item.location,
      salary: item.salary,
      source_type: item.sourceType,
      source_name: item.sourceChannel,
      source_url: item.applyUrl,
      description: item.description,
      tags: item.tags,
      published_at: item.publishedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const { error } = await supabase.from('internships').upsert(row, { onConflict: 'id' });
    if (error) {
      console.warn('Failed to insert internship to Supabase:', error.message);
      isSupabaseOffline = true;
      return true;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Exception adding internship to Supabase, stored in memory:', err);
    isSupabaseOffline = true;
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Save / Update Telegram subscription
 */
export async function saveSubscriptionToSupabase(sub: TelegramSubscription): Promise<boolean> {
  inMemorySubscriptions.set(String(sub.chat_id), sub);

  if (isSupabaseOffline) return true;

  try {
    const row = {
      chat_id: String(sub.chat_id),
      username: sub.username || '',
      first_name: sub.first_name || '',
      directions: sub.directions,
      sub_tracks: sub.sub_tracks,
      is_active: sub.is_active,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('tg_subscriptions')
      .upsert(row, { onConflict: 'chat_id' });

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase upsert subscription warning:', error.message);
      isSupabaseOffline = true;
      return true;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase subscription exception, stored in memory:', err);
    isSupabaseOffline = true;
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Get active subscriptions
 */
export async function fetchSubscriptionsFromSupabase(): Promise<TelegramSubscription[]> {
  if (isSupabaseOffline) {
    return Array.from(inMemorySubscriptions.values()).filter((s) => s.is_active);
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('tg_subscriptions')
      .select('*')
      .eq('is_active', true);

    if (error || !data) {
      isSupabaseOffline = true;
      return Array.from(inMemorySubscriptions.values()).filter((s) => s.is_active);
    }

    const fetched = data.map((d: any) => ({
      chat_id: d.chat_id,
      username: d.username,
      first_name: d.first_name,
      directions: Array.isArray(d.directions) ? d.directions : [],
      sub_tracks: Array.isArray(d.sub_tracks) ? d.sub_tracks : [],
      is_active: d.is_active,
      created_at: d.created_at,
    }));

    fetched.forEach((s: TelegramSubscription) => inMemorySubscriptions.set(String(s.chat_id), s));
    return fetched;
  } catch {
    isSupabaseOffline = true;
    return Array.from(inMemorySubscriptions.values()).filter((s) => s.is_active);
  }
}

/**
 * Save user progress to Supabase
 */
export async function saveUserProgressToSupabase(
  userId: string | number,
  progress: UserProgress
): Promise<boolean> {
  inMemoryUserProgress.set(String(userId), progress);

  if (isSupabaseOffline) return true;

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('user_progress').upsert(
      {
        user_key: String(userId),
        completed_nodes: progress.completedTopics,
        completed_questions: progress.completedQuestions,
        saved_internships: [],
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      { onConflict: 'user_key' }
    );

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Error saving user progress to Supabase:', error.message);
      isSupabaseOffline = true;
      return true;
    }
    return true;
  } catch {
    isSupabaseOffline = true;
    return true;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { GITHUB_PAGES_URL, TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME } from './supabase';
import type { TelegramUser } from '../types';
import { isVkMiniApp } from './vkBridge';

declare global {
  interface Window {
    Telegram?: {
      WebApp?: {

        close: () => void;
        initData: string;
        initDataUnsafe?: {

          hash?: string;
        };
        themeParams?: Record<string, string>;
        isExpanded?: boolean;
        viewportHeight?: number;
        viewportStableHeight?: number;
        headerColor?: string;
        backgroundColor?: string;
        setHeaderColor?: (color: string) => void;
        setBackgroundColor?: (color: string) => void;
        openTelegramLink: (url: string) => void;
        openLink: (url: string) => void;
        HapticFeedback?: {
          impactOccurred: (style: 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' | 'rigid' | 'soft') => void;
          notificationOccurred: (type: 'error' | 'success' | 'warning') => void;
          selectionChanged: () => void;
        };
      };
    };
  }
}

const BOT_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY = 'it_start_bot_token';
const TELEGRAM_USER_STORAGE_KEY = 'it_start_tg_user';

let cachedTelegramUser: TelegramUser | null = null;

export function parseTelegramUserFromRawString(raw?: string): TelegramUser | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    let clean = raw.trim();
    if (clean.startsWith('#') || clean.startsWith('?')) {
      clean = clean.slice(1);
    }
    const params = new URLSearchParams(clean);

    // 1. Direct query / hash parameter checks: tg_chat_id, chat_id, tg_user_id, tg_id
    const directChatId =
      params.get('tg_chat_id') ||
      params.get('chat_id') ||
      params.get('tg_user_id') ||
      params.get('tg_id');
    if (directChatId && /^\d+$/.test(directChatId)) {
      const usernameParam = params.get('tg_username') || params.get('username') || '';
      return {
        id: Number(directChatId),
        first_name: params.get('tg_first_name') || params.get('first_name') || 'Пользователь Telegram',
        last_name: params.get('tg_last_name') || params.get('last_name') || undefined,
        username: usernameParam ? usernameParam.replace(/^@/, '') : undefined,
        photo_url: params.get('tg_photo_url') || params.get('photo_url') || undefined,
      };
    }

    // 2. Check for user JSON string directly or inside tgWebAppData
    let userRaw = params.get('user');
    if (!userRaw && params.get('tgWebAppData')) {
      const nested = new URLSearchParams(params.get('tgWebAppData') || '');
      userRaw = nested.get('user');

      // Nested direct chat_id check inside tgWebAppData
      const nestedChatId = nested.get('tg_chat_id') || nested.get('chat_id') || nested.get('id');
      if (!userRaw && nestedChatId && /^\d+$/.test(nestedChatId)) {
        const nestedUsername = nested.get('username') || nested.get('tg_username') || '';
        return {
          id: Number(nestedChatId),
          first_name: nested.get('first_name') || nested.get('tg_first_name') || 'Пользователь Telegram',
          last_name: nested.get('last_name') || undefined,
          username: nestedUsername ? nestedUsername.replace(/^@/, '') : undefined,
        };
      }
    }

    if (userRaw) {
      const decoded = decodeURIComponent(userRaw);
      const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
      if (parsed && (typeof parsed.id === 'number' || (typeof parsed.id === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(parsed.id)))) {
        return {
          ...parsed,
          id: Number(parsed.id),
        } as TelegramUser;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    try {
      const match = raw.match(/user=({.+?})(?:&|$)/);
      if (match) {
        const decoded = decodeURIComponent(match[1]);
        const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
        if (parsed && (typeof parsed.id === 'number' || (typeof parsed.id === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(parsed.id)))) {
          return {
            ...parsed,
            id: Number(parsed.id),
          } as TelegramUser;
        }
      }
      const idMatch = raw.match(/(?:tg_chat_id|chat_id)=(\d+)/);
      if (idMatch) {
        return {
          id: Number(idMatch[1]),
          first_name: 'Пользователь Telegram',
        };
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
}

export function getCachedTelegramUser(): TelegramUser | null {
  if (cachedTelegramUser) return cachedTelegramUser;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(TELEGRAM_USER_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      cachedTelegramUser = JSON.parse(saved);
      return cachedTelegramUser;
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

export function setCachedTelegramUser(user: TelegramUser | null): void {
  cachedTelegramUser = user;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  if (user) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(TELEGRAM_USER_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
    } catch {}
  } else {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(TELEGRAM_USER_STORAGE_KEY);
    } catch {}
  }
}

export function isTelegramWebApp(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  if (window.Telegram?.WebApp?.initDataUnsafe?.user) return true;
  if (window.Telegram?.WebApp?.initData && window.Telegram.WebApp.initData.length > 0) return true;
  if (typeof window.location !== 'undefined') {
    const s = window.location.search || '';
    const h = window.location.hash || '';
    if (s.includes('tgWebAppData') || h.includes('tgWebAppData')) return true;
    if (s.includes('tgWebAppVersion') || h.includes('tgWebAppVersion')) return true;
    if (s.includes('tg_chat_id') || h.includes('tg_chat_id')) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function getTelegramWebApp() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.Telegram?.WebApp) {
    return window.Telegram.WebApp;
  }
  return null;
}

export function initTelegramWebApp(): TelegramUser | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;

  const webApp = getTelegramWebApp();
  let user: TelegramUser | null = null;

  if (webApp) {
    try {
      webApp.ready();
      webApp.expand();
      if (typeof webApp.setHeaderColor === 'function') webApp.setHeaderColor('#dbe0ea');
      if (typeof webApp.setBackgroundColor === 'function') webApp.setBackgroundColor('#dbe0ea');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error expanding Telegram WebApp:', e);
    }

    if (webApp.initDataUnsafe?.user && (typeof webApp.initDataUnsafe.user.id === 'number' || typeof (webApp.initDataUnsafe.user as any).id === 'string')) {
      const u = webApp.initDataUnsafe.user;
      user = {
        ...u,
        id: Number(u.id),
      };
    } else if (webApp.initData) {
      user = parseTelegramUserFromRawString(webApp.initData);
    }
  }

  // Fallback to URL parameters (search query string first, then hash)
  if (!user && typeof window.location !== 'undefined') {
    user =
      parseTelegramUserFromRawString(window.location.search) ||
      parseTelegramUserFromRawString(window.location.hash);
  }

  // Fallback to cached localStorage user
  if (!user) {
    user = getCachedTelegramUser();
  }

  if (user) {
    setCachedTelegramUser(user);
  }

  return user;
}

export function triggerHaptic(type: 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' | 'success' | 'selection' = 'light') {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  // 1. Telegram WebApp Haptic
  const webApp = getTelegramWebApp();
  if (webApp?.HapticFeedback) {
    try {
      if (type === 'success') {
        webApp.HapticFeedback.notificationOccurred('success');
      } else if (type === 'selection') {
        webApp.HapticFeedback.selectionChanged();
      } else {
        webApp.HapticFeedback.impactOccurred(type);
      }
      return;
    } catch {
      // Ignore haptic errors
    }
  }

  // 2. VK Mini App Taptic (VK Bridge)
  if (isVkMiniApp() && window.vkBridge && typeof window.vkBridge.send === 'function') {
    try {
      if (type === 'success') {
        window.vkBridge.send('VKWebAppTapticNotificationOccurred', { result_type: 'success' }).catch(() => {});
      } else if (type === 'selection') {
        window.vkBridge.send('VKWebAppTapticSelectionChanged', {}).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        const style = type === 'medium' || type === 'heavy' ? type : 'light';
        window.vkBridge.send('VKWebAppTapticImpactOccurred', { style }).catch(() => {});
      }
      return;
    } catch {
      // Ignore haptic errors
    }
  }

  // 3. Fallback to standard Navigator Vibration API if supported
  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator) {
    try {
      navigator.vibrate(type === 'selection' ? 10 : 25);
    } catch {
      // Ignore vibration errors
    }
  }
}

export function getSavedBotToken(): string {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';
  return localStorage.getItem(BOT_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY) || '';
}

export function saveBotToken(token: string): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  if (token.trim()) {
    localStorage.setItem(BOT_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY, token.trim());
  } else {
    localStorage.removeItem(BOT_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY);
  }
}

/**
 * Send real Telegram message via Telegram Bot API
 */
export async function sendTelegramMessage(
  chatId: string | number,
  text: string,
  botToken?: string,
  buttonText = '🚀 Открыть IT-Старт',
  buttonUrl = GITHUB_PAGES_URL,
  actionButton?: { text: string; url: string }
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; messageId?: number }> {
  const token = botToken || getSavedBotToken();

  // 1. Direct Telegram Bot API call if token is provided
  if (token) {
    const endpoint = `https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/sendMessage`;
    const inlineKeyboard: any[][] = [];

    if (actionButton && actionButton.url) {
      inlineKeyboard.push([
        {
          text: actionButton.text,
          url: actionButton.url,
        },
      ]);
    }

    inlineKeyboard.push([
      {
        text: buttonText,
        web_app: {
          url: buttonUrl,
        },
      },
    ]);

    inlineKeyboard.push([
      {
        text: '💬 Бот @' + TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME,
        url: `https://t.me/${TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME}`,
      },
    ]);

    const payload: any = {
      chat_id: chatId,
      text: text,
      parse_mode: 'HTML',
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: inlineKeyboard,
      },
    };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: data.description || 'Ошибка Telegram Bot API при отправке сообщения',
        };
      }

      return {
        success: true,
        messageId: data.result?.message_id,
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Сетевая ошибка при обращении к api.telegram.org',
      };
    }
  }

  // 2. Client has no local bot token -> attempt sending via backend /notify on Render
  try {
    const notifyRes = await fetch('https://it-start-bot.onrender.com/notify', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        chatId,
        text,
        actionButton,
        applyUrl: actionButton?.url,
        buttonText,
        buttonUrl,
      }),
    });

    if (notifyRes.ok) {
      const notifyData = await notifyRes.json();
      if (notifyData.success) {
        return {
          success: true,
          messageId: notifyData.messageId || Date.now(),
        };
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Backend might be offline or sleeping on free tier
  }

  // 3. Fallback: subscription is saved in Supabase and polled by the backend bot
  return {
    success: true,
    messageId: Date.now(),
  };
}

/**
 * Fetch latest chat ID from getUpdates for auto-detection in browser
 */
export async function autoDetectChatIdFromUpdates(
  botToken?: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; chatId?: number; username?: string; firstName?: string; error?: string }> {
  const token = botToken || getSavedBotToken();

  if (!token) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Укажите Bot Token для автоматического поиска Chat ID через getUpdates',
    };
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/getUpdates?offset=-10&limit=10`);
    const data = await res.json();

    if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: data.description || 'Не удалось получить обновления бота от Telegram',
      };
    }

    const updates = data.result || [];
    if (updates.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Пока нет сообщений в боте. Сначала откройте бота @IT_start_izh_bot и отправьте команду /start, затем повторите поиск!',
      };
    }

    // Find latest message or callback
    for (let i = updates.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const u = updates[i];
      const msg = u.message || u.edited_message || u.channel_post || u.callback_query?.message;
      const user = msg?.from || u.callback_query?.from;
      if (user && user.id) {
        return {
          success: true,
          chatId: user.id,
          username: user.username,
          firstName: user.first_name,
        };
      }
    }

    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Не удалось извлечь Chat ID из последних сообщений. Отправьте /start боту и попробуйте снова.',
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: err.message || 'Ошибка соединения с Telegram API',
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { useEffect } from 'react';

let lockCount = 0;
let prevBodyOverflow = '';
let prevBodyTouchAction = '';
let prevHtmlOverflow = '';
let prevBodyPaddingRight = '';

/**
 * Custom hook to lock body scrolling when a modal or overlay is open.
 * Prevents mobile background scroll thrashing, GPU overdraw, and layout shift.
 */
export function useScrollLock(lock: boolean) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!lock || typeof document === 'undefined') return;

    if (lockCount === 0) {
      prevBodyOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
      prevBodyTouchAction = document.body.style.touchAction;
      prevHtmlOverflow = document.documentElement.style.overflow;
      prevBodyPaddingRight = document.body.style.paddingRight;

      // Compensate for scrollbar disappearance on desktop to avoid layout shift
      const scrollBarWidth = window.innerWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth;
      if (scrollBarWidth > 0) {
        document.body.style.paddingRight = `${scrollBarWidth}px`;
      }

      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      document.body.style.touchAction = 'none';
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      document.documentElement.classList.add('modal-open');
    }
    lockCount++;

    return () => {
      lockCount--;
      if (lockCount <= 0) {
        lockCount = 0;
        document.body.style.overflow = prevBodyOverflow;
        document.body.style.touchAction = prevBodyTouchAction;
        document.documentElement.style.overflow = prevHtmlOverflow;
        document.body.style.paddingRight = prevBodyPaddingRight;
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('modal-open');
      }
    };
  }, [lock]);
}
```

```typescript
import type { DirectionId, SubTrackId } from '../types';

/**
 * Official verified direct career portals and links for target companies
 */
export const COMPANY_OFFICIAL_PORTALS: Record<string, string> = {
  tbank: 'https://education.tbank.ru/start/',
  kontur: 'https://kontur.ru/career/vacancies/intern-frontend',

/**
 * Normalizes company identifier from company name or text
 */
export function getCompanyKey(companyName = ''): string {
  const c = companyName.toLowerCase();
  if (c.includes('т-банк') || c.includes('тинькофф') || c.includes('tbank') || c.includes('tinkoff')) return 'tbank';
  if (c.includes('контур') || c.includes('kontur')) return 'kontur';
  if (c.includes('directum') || c.includes('директ')) return 'directum';
  if (c.includes('т1') || c.includes('t1')) return 't1';
  if (c.includes('яндекс') || c.includes('yandex')) return 'yandex';
  if (c.includes('ozon') || c.includes('озон')) return 'ozon';
  if (c.includes('сбер') || c.includes('sber')) return 'sber';
  if (c.includes('авито') || c.includes('avito')) return 'avito';
  if (c.includes('vk') || c.includes('вконтакте')) return 'vk';
  return 'other';
}

/**
 * Returns a clean, recognizable monogram (1-2 uppercase letters) for matte glass squircle tiles
 */
export function getCompanyMonogram(companyName = ''): string {
  const key = getCompanyKey(companyName);
  switch (key) {
    case 't1':
      return 'Т1';

/**
 * Resolves an application URL, guaranteeing it leads strictly to a working direct vacancy page,
 * specific Telegram post, or direct job board item instead of a generic homepage
 * (e.g. root avito.ru, career.avito.com), empty search query (?search=), or broken shortener.
 */
export function resolveApplyUrl(
  rawUrl: string | undefined,
  companyName = '',
  sourceChannel = '',
  directionId?: string
): string {
  const companyKey = getCompanyKey(companyName);
  const directPortal = getDirectVacancyPortalUrl(companyKey, directionId);

  // If sourceChannel points to a specific post in Telegram, store it for fallback
  const hasSpecificPostSource =
    sourceChannel && /^https?:\/\/t\.me\/[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\/\d+/i.test(sourceChannel.trim());
  const fallbackDirect = hasSpecificPostSource ? sourceChannel.trim() : directPortal;

  if (!rawUrl || typeof rawUrl !== 'string') {
    if (sourceChannel) {
      const trimmedSource = sourceChannel.trim();
      if (/^https?:\/\/t\.me\/[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\/\d+/i.test(trimmedSource)) {
        return trimmedSource;
      }
    }
    return directPortal;
  }

  const trimmed = rawUrl.trim();

  // 1. Direct Telegram post link (e.g. https://t.me/channel/123 or t.me/channel/123)
  if (/^https?:\/\/t\.me\/[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\/\d+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed;
  }
  if (/^t\.me\/[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\/\d+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return `https://${trimmed}`;
  }

  // 2. Relative job board vacancy URLs (/vacancy/<id> for hh, /vacancies/<id> for habr, /vacancies/.../<id> for avito)
  if (/^\/vacancy\/\d+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return `https://hh.ru${trimmed.split('?')[0]}`;
  }
  if (/^\/vacancies\/\d+/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return `https://career.habr.com${trimmed.split('?')[0]}`;
  }
  if (/^\/vacancies\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\/\d+\/?/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return `https://career.avito.com${trimmed.split('?')[0]}`;
  }

  // 3. Direct job boards with concrete vacancy ID (hh.ru/vacancy/<id>, career.habr.com/vacancies/<id>)
  if (
    /https?:\/\/hh\.ru\/vacancy\/\d+/i.test(trimmed) ||
    /https?:\/\/career\.habr\.com\/vacancies\/\d+/i.test(trimmed)
  ) {
    return trimmed.split('?')[0];
  }
  if (
    /^hh\.ru\/vacancy\/\d+/i.test(trimmed) ||
    /^career\.habr\.com\/vacancies\/\d+/i.test(trimmed)
  ) {
    return `https://${trimmed.split('?')[0]}`;
  }

  // 4. Shorteners and non-career aggregators
  if (
    trimmed.includes('bit.ly') ||
    trimmed.includes('vk.cc') ||
    trimmed.includes('clck.ru') ||
    trimmed.includes('vc.ru') ||
    trimmed.includes('timepad.ru') ||
    trimmed.includes('youtube.com') ||
    trimmed.includes('digital')
  ) {
    return fallbackDirect;
  }

  // 5. Eliminate generic search and root URLs that dump users into general search
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  const isGenericSearchOrRoot =
    lower.includes('?search=') ||
    lower.includes('&search=') ||
    lower.includes('?direction=') ||
    lower.includes('&direction=') ||
    lower.includes('?text=') ||
    lower.includes('/search/') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancies/?') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancies?') ||
    // Avito generic
    lower === 'https://career.avito.com/' ||
    lower === 'https://career.avito.com' ||
    lower === 'https://avito.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://avito.ru' ||
    lower === 'https://www.avito.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://www.avito.ru' ||
    lower === 'https://career.avito.com/vacancies' ||
    lower === 'https://career.avito.com/vacancies/' ||
    lower.includes('career.avito.com/internship') ||
    // Directum generic
    lower === 'https://career.directum.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://career.directum.ru' ||
    lower.includes('lead_product_owner') ||
    // Kontur generic
    lower === 'https://kontur.ru/career/' ||
    lower === 'https://kontur.ru/career' ||
    lower === 'https://kontur.ru/career/vacancies' ||
    lower === 'https://kontur.ru/career/vacancies/' ||
    // T1 generic
    lower === 'https://career.t1.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://career.t1.ru' ||
    lower.includes('t1.ru/school') ||
    // Yandex generic
    lower === 'https://yandex.ru/jobs/' ||
    lower === 'https://yandex.ru/jobs' ||
    lower.includes('yabackend') ||
    // Ozon generic
    lower === 'https://job.ozon.ru/it/' ||
    lower === 'https://job.ozon.ru/it' ||
    lower === 'https://job.ozon.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://job.ozon.ru' ||
    // Sber generic
    lower === 'https://sbergraduate.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://sbergraduate.ru' ||
    lower === 'https://sbergraduate.ru/sberseasons-moscow/' ||
    lower === 'https://sbergraduate.ru/sberseasons-moscow' ||
    // Obsolete & 404 employer links that must be rerouted to live verified portals
    lower.includes('education.tbank.ru/start/sre') ||
    lower.includes('fintech.tbank.ru') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancy/web-developer') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancy/backend-csharp') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancy/qa-engineer') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancies/java-developer') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancies/devops-engineer') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancies/qa-automation') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancies/razrabotka/20805') ||
    lower.includes('/vacancies/razrabotka/20808') ||
    lower.includes('/internship/web') ||
    lower.includes('/internship/backend') ||
    lower.includes('/internship/qa') ||
    lower.includes('/internship/data') ||
    lower.includes('/internship/mobile') ||
    lower.includes('yandex.ru/jobs/pages/internship') ||
    // T-Bank generic
    lower === 'https://education.tbank.ru' ||
    lower === 'https://education.tbank.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://education.tbank.ru/start' ||
    lower === 'https://education.tbank.ru/start/' ||
    lower === 'https://fintech.tbank.ru' ||
    lower === 'https://fintech.tbank.ru/' ||
    lower === 'https://fintech.tbank.ru/start' ||
    lower === 'https://fintech.tbank.ru/start/' ||
    lower === 'https://www.tbank.ru/career/it/' ||
    lower === 'https://www.tbank.ru/career/it' ||
    lower === 'https://tbank.ru/career/it/' ||
    lower === 'https://tbank.ru/career/it' ||
    // VK generic
    lower === 'https://internship.vk.company/' ||
    lower === 'https://internship.vk.company' ||
    // HH generic
    lower === 'https://hh.ru' ||
    lower === 'https://hh.ru/' ||
    lower.startsWith('https://hh.ru/search') ||
    // Habr generic
    lower === 'https://career.habr.com' ||
    lower === 'https://career.habr.com/' ||
    lower.startsWith('https://career.habr.com/companies/');

  if (isGenericSearchOrRoot) {
    return fallbackDirect;
  }

  // 6. Bare telegram channel without post number
  if (trimmed.startsWith('@') || /^https?:\/\/t\.me\/[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\/?$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return fallbackDirect;
  }

  // 7. Direct company vacancy detail page with actual vacancy slug or ID
  if (
    trimmed.includes('/yaintern/') ||
    trimmed.includes('career.directum.ru/vacancy') ||
    trimmed.includes('career.t1.ru/vacancies') ||
    trimmed.includes('internship.vk.company/internship') ||
    trimmed.includes('internship.vk.company/vacancy') ||
    trimmed.includes('education.tbank.ru/start/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/vacancies/razrabotka/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/vacancies/data-science/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/vacancies/analitika-dannykh/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/camp/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/intern-') ||
    trimmed.includes('/sberseasons-moscow/ml/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/sberseasons-moscow/java/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/sberseasons-moscow/devops/') ||
    trimmed.includes('/sberseasons-moscow/qa/')
  ) {
    return trimmed.startsWith('http') ? trimmed : `https://${trimmed.replace(/^\/+/, '')}`;
  }

  // 8. General absolute vacancy ID pattern (e.g. https://domain.com/vacancies/<category>/<number>/)
  if (/^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/vacancies\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\/\d+\/?/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  return fallbackDirect;
}

/**
 * Resolves Telegram channel handles to valid existing public channels.
 * Fixes broken handles like @kontur_career -> @KonturTech.
 */
export function resolveChannelHandle(channel: string | undefined, companyName = ''): string {
  if (!channel) {
    const compKey = getCompanyKey(companyName);
    switch (compKey) {
      case 'kontur':
        return '@KonturTech';
      case 'directum':
        return '@Life_in_Directum';
      case 't1':
        return '@t1career';
      case 'yandex':
        return '@yandex_intern';
      case 'tbank':
      default:
        return '@tbank_team';
    }
  }

  const clean = channel.trim().replace(/^@/, '');
  const lower = clean.toLowerCase();

  if (lower === 'kontur_career') return '@KonturTech';
  if (lower === 'directum_career' || lower === 'directum_careers') return '@Life_in_Directum';
  if (lower === 't1_holding') return '@t1career';
  if (lower === 'tbank_career' || lower === 'tinkoff_jobs') return '@tbank_team';

  return channel.startsWith('@') ? channel : `@${channel}`;
}

/**
 * Uniformly formats vacancy salary into a clean range («от 50 000 до 75 000 ₽», «от 60 000 ₽»)
 * or strictly «По договорённости».
 * Eliminates garbage artifacts, empty values, duplicated currencies, and non-price strings.
 */
export function formatSalary(salaryInput: any): string {
  if (!salaryInput) return 'По договорённости';

  // 1. If object from HH/job board API: { from, to, amount, value, currency }
  if (typeof salaryInput === 'object') {
    const from = salaryInput.from;
    const to = salaryInput.to;
    const amount = salaryInput.amount ?? salaryInput.value;
    const currency = salaryInput.currency;
    const numFrom =
      typeof from === 'number' && !isNaN(from)
        ? from
        : typeof from === 'string'
        ? parseInt(from.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10)
        : null;
    const numTo =
      typeof to === 'number' && !isNaN(to)
        ? to
        : typeof to === 'string'
        ? parseInt(to.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10)
        : null;
    const numAmount =
      typeof amount === 'number' && !isNaN(amount)
        ? amount
        : typeof amount === 'string'
        ? parseInt(amount.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10)
        : null;

    if (!numFrom && !numTo && !numAmount) return 'По договорённости';
    const currSymbol = !currency || currency === 'RUR' || currency === 'RUB' ? '₽' : currency;
    const fmt = (n: number) => String(n).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ' ');

    if (numFrom && numTo) {
      if (numFrom === numTo) return `${fmt(numFrom)} ${currSymbol}`;
      return `от ${fmt(numFrom)} до ${fmt(numTo)} ${currSymbol}`;
    }
    if (numFrom) return `от ${fmt(numFrom)} ${currSymbol}`;
    if (numTo) return `до ${fmt(numTo)} ${currSymbol}`;
    if (numAmount) return `${fmt(numAmount)} ${currSymbol}`;
    return 'По договорённости';
  }

  const str = String(salaryInput).trim();
  const lower = str.toLowerCase();

  // Non-salary placeholders or empty strings
  if (
    !str ||
    lower.includes('договор') ||
    lower.includes('оплачив') ||
    lower.includes('не указан') ||
    lower.includes('согласован') ||
    lower.includes('бесплатн') ||
    lower.includes('не оплачив') ||
    lower.includes('undefined') ||
    lower.includes('null')
  ) {
    return 'По договорённости';
  }

  // If already cleanly formatted, ensure it uses standard spaces and ends with ₽
  const cleanFmtRegex =
    /^(?:от\s+\d{1,3}(?:\s\d{3})*(?:\s+до\s+\d{1,3}(?:\s\d{3})*)?|до\s+\d{1,3}(?:\s\d{3})*|\d{1,3}(?:\s\d{3})*)\s*₽$/;
  const normalizedSpaces = str.replace(/[\u00A0\s]+/g, ' ');
  if (cleanFmtRegex.test(normalizedSpaces)) {
    return normalizedSpaces;
  }

  const fmt = (n: number) => String(n).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ' ');

  // Parse numbers from strings like "от 50 000 до 75 000 руб", "60-80k", "от 70 тыс руб"
  const rangeMatch = normalizedSpaces.match(
    /(?:от\s*)?(\d+[\d\s]*)(?:\s*(?:тыс|k|к))?\s*(?:до|[-–—])\s*(\d+[\d\s]*)(?:\s*(?:тыс|k|к))?/i
  );
  if (rangeMatch) {
    let n1 = parseInt(rangeMatch[1].replace(/\s/g, ''), 10);
    let n2 = parseInt(rangeMatch[2].replace(/\s/g, ''), 10);
    if (n1 < 500) n1 *= 1000;
    if (n2 < 500) n2 *= 1000;
    if (n1 >= 10000 && n2 >= 10000) {
      if (n1 === n2) return `от ${fmt(n1)} ₽`;
      return `от ${fmt(n1)} до ${fmt(n2)} ₽`;
    }
  }

  // From: от X
  const fromMatch = normalizedSpaces.match(/от\s*(\d+[\d\s]*)(?:\s*(?:тыс|k|к))?/i);
  if (fromMatch) {
    let n = parseInt(fromMatch[1].replace(/\s/g, ''), 10);
    if (n < 500) n *= 1000;
    if (n >= 10000) return `от ${fmt(n)} ₽`;
  }

  // To: до X
  const toMatch = normalizedSpaces.match(/до\s*(\d+[\d\s]*)(?:\s*(?:тыс|k|к))?/i);
  if (toMatch) {
    let n = parseInt(toMatch[1].replace(/\s/g, ''), 10);
    if (n < 500) n *= 1000;
    if (n >= 10000) return `до ${fmt(n)} ₽`;
  }

  // Single number with currency
  const singleMatch = normalizedSpaces.match(/(\d+[\d\s]*)(?:\s*(?:тыс|k|к))?\s*(?:₽|руб)/i);
  if (singleMatch) {
    let n = parseInt(singleMatch[1].replace(/\s/g, ''), 10);
    if (n < 500) n *= 1000;
    if (n >= 10000) return `${fmt(n)} ₽`;
  }

  return 'По договорённости';
}

/**
 * Strict validator for real IT internship and junior positions.
 * Excludes non-IT vacancies (sales, support, call-center, operators, lawyers, accounting,
 * logistics, couriers, marketing, PR, SMM, fraud monitoring, office administration)
 * and commercial courses/ads.
 * Ensures the position strictly belongs to one of the 6 IT directions:
 * Frontend, Backend, Mobile, QA, DevOps/Cloud, Data Science/Analytics.
 */
export function isStrictVacancyPost(title = '', text = ''): boolean {
  const titleLower = title.toLowerCase();
  const combined = `${title} ${text}`.toLowerCase();

  // 1. Strict STOP WORDS (PR, news, celebrations, contests, courses, conferences, video clips, outages)
  const stopWords = [
    'девушки в', 'девушек в',
    'подкаст', 'podcast',
    'опрос', 'голосован', 'голосуйте',
    'вебинар', 'митап', 'meetup', 'круглый стол',
    'поздравл', 'с 8 марта', 'с новым годом', 'с праздником',
    'итоги года', 'розыгрыш', 'дарим', 'мерч', 'футболк',
    'статья на хабр', 'vc.ru', 'habr.com/ru/articles',
    'какая ide', 'какую ide',
    'сегодня важный день', 'нужно только рассказать',
    'где-то ходит один', 'отменяет плату',
    'конкурс школьниц', 'школьниц', 'авиация начинается',
    'всего за 10 недель', 'за 10 недель', 'за 3 месяца', 'курс с нуля',
    'записаться на курс', 'скидка на обучение', 'гарантия трудоустройства',
    'первая линия поддержки', 'холодные звонки', 'исходящие звонки',
    'продажа кредитов', 'оформление полисов', 'первичной документации',
    // Events, games, battles, conferences, video clips, and system outages
    'батл для', 'архитектурная игра', 'архитектурный батл', 'батл разработчиков',
    'dotnext', 'highload', 'joker conf', 'holyjs', 'конференц', 'по следам нашей поездки',
    'сделали ролик', 'посмотрите ролик', 'видеоролик', 'прогуляйтесь по конфе',
    'доля доступных файлов', 'доступ к файлам', 'работают все базовые функции диска',
    'сбой в работе', 'восстановление сервиса'
  ];

  for (const stop of stopWords) {
    if (combined.includes(stop)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // 2. Non-IT roles in title or specific non-tech title keywords
  const nonItTitles = [
    'продаж', 'продавец', 'кассир', 'ритейл', 'торговый',
    'call-центр', 'колл-центр', 'коллцентр', 'телемаркетинг',
    'саппорт', 'support', 'поддержк', 'выездного сервиса',
    'юрист', 'юрисконсульт', 'правовед', 'адвокат', 'судебн', 'комплаенс',
    'бухгалтер', 'экономист', 'аудитор', 'налогов', 'первичк',
    'страхование', 'страхован', 'осаго', 'каско', 'андеррайтер',
    'водитель', 'курьер', 'экспедитор', 'склад', 'кладовщик', 'комплектовщик', 'грузчик',
    'мерчендайзер', 'повар', 'уборщик', 'клининг', 'охрана', 'охранник', 'фасовщик',
    'маркетинг', 'маркетолог', 'таргетолог', 'контекстолог', 'копирайтер', 'smm', 'смм', 'пиар', 'seo', 'видеокреатор',
    'партнерств', 'partnerships', 'аккаунт-менеджер',
    'рекрутер', 'recruitment', 'подбор персонала', 'ресёрчер', 'ресечер', 'hr-', 'hr ',
    'администратор', 'офис-менеджер', 'дежурной смены', 'дежурн',
    'модератор', 'модерация', 'фрод-мониторинг', 'фрод', 'антифрод',
    'недвижимост', 'риск-менеджер', 'риск менеджер',
    'менеджер проектов', 'project manager', 'продакт-менеджер', 'product manager',
    'кипиа', 'кип и а', 'инженер-конструктор', '1с', '1c ',
    'информационной безопасности', 'информационная безопасность', 'инфобез'
  ];

  for (const nonIt of nonItTitles) {
    if (titleLower.includes(nonIt)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // 3. Reject senior / middle / lead / architect roles unless explicitly an internship / junior
  const isSeniorOrLeadOrMiddle =
    titleLower.includes('старший') ||
    titleLower.includes('senior') ||
    titleLower.includes('сеньор') ||
    titleLower.includes('руководитель') ||
    titleLower.includes('lead') ||
    titleLower.includes('head of') ||
    titleLower.includes('главный инженер') ||
    titleLower.includes('middle') ||
    titleLower.includes('мидл') ||
    titleLower.includes('миддл') ||
    titleLower.includes('ведущий') ||
    titleLower.includes('архитектор') ||
    titleLower.includes('architect');

  const hasExplicitJuniorOrIntern =
    titleLower.includes('стаж') ||
    titleLower.includes('junior') ||
    titleLower.includes('джун') ||
    titleLower.includes('intern') ||
    titleLower.includes('trainee') ||
    titleLower.includes('младш');

  if (isSeniorOrLeadOrMiddle && !hasExplicitJuniorOrIntern) {
    return false;
  }

  // 4. Must indicate IT / engineering direction or technical skills
  const techKeywords = [
    'разработчик', 'developer', 'инженер', 'engineer',
    'программист', 'тестиров', 'qa', 'devops', 'sre',
    'frontend', 'фронтенд', 'backend', 'бэкенд', 'fullstack',
    'python', 'java', 'c#', '.net', 'golang', 'go', 'react', 'vue', 'angular',
    'javascript', 'typescript', 'sql', 'postgresql', 'docker', 'kubernetes',
    'android', 'ios', 'kotlin', 'swift', 'data science', 'ml', 'machine learning',
    'data analyst', 'аналитик данных', 'продуктовый аналитик', 'системный аналитик',
    'data engineer', 'инженер данных', 'flutter', 'nlp', 'prompt'
  ];
  if (!techKeywords.some((k) => combined.includes(k))) return false;

  // 5. Must indicate trainee / junior / internship program
  const roleKeywords = [
    'стаж', 'стажировк', 'intern', 'trainee',
    'junior', 'джуниор', 'джун', 'младш',
    'открытая школа', 'школа разработк', 'контур.старт', 'контур старт',
    'ozon camp', 'sberseasons', 'авито старт', 'avito start', 'young con',
    'для студентов', 'студенческая практика', 'практикант'
  ];
  if (!roleKeywords.some((k) => combined.includes(k))) return false;

  return true;
}

/**
 * Detects the technical direction and sub-track of a vacancy based on its title and description.
 */
export function detectVacancyTrack(
  title = '',
  text = ''
): { directionId: DirectionId; subTrackId: SubTrackId } {
  const combined = `${title} ${text}`.toLowerCase();

  if (
    combined.includes('react') ||
    combined.includes('frontend') ||
    combined.includes('фронтенд') ||
    combined.includes('typescript') ||
    combined.includes('vue') ||
    combined.includes('angular') ||
    combined.includes('веб-разработчик') ||
    combined.includes('web-разработчик')
  ) {
    const subTrackId: SubTrackId = combined.includes('vue')
      ? 'vue'
      : combined.includes('angular')
      ? 'angular'
      : 'react';
    return { directionId: 'frontend', subTrackId };
  }

  if (
    combined.includes('qa') ||
    combined.includes('тестиров') ||
    combined.includes('тестирован') ||
    combined.includes('тест-инженер') ||
    combined.includes('quality assurance')
  ) {
    const subTrackId: SubTrackId =
      combined.includes('auto') || combined.includes('автомат') || combined.includes('python')
        ? 'auto_qa'
        : 'manual_qa';
    return { directionId: 'qa', subTrackId };
  }

  if (
    combined.includes('devops') ||
    combined.includes('sre') ||
    combined.includes('kubernetes') ||
    combined.includes('docker') ||
    combined.includes('облак') ||
    combined.includes('cloud') ||
    combined.includes('инфраструктур') ||
    combined.includes('системный администратор')
  ) {
    const subTrackId: SubTrackId =
      combined.includes('k8s') || combined.includes('kubernetes') ? 'k8s_iac' : 'cicd_docker';
    return { directionId: 'devops', subTrackId };
  }

  if (
    combined.includes('data science') ||
    combined.includes('ml') ||
    combined.includes('машинн') ||
    combined.includes('ai') ||
    combined.includes('аналитик') ||
    combined.includes('data engineer')
  ) {
    const subTrackId: SubTrackId =
      combined.includes('ml') || combined.includes('машинн') ? 'ml' : 'analytics';
    return { directionId: 'data_science', subTrackId };
  }

  if (
    combined.includes('android') ||
    combined.includes('ios') ||
    combined.includes('flutter') ||
    combined.includes('мобильн') ||
    combined.includes('mobile')
  ) {
    const subTrackId: SubTrackId = combined.includes('ios')
      ? 'ios'
      : combined.includes('flutter')
      ? 'flutter'
      : 'android';
    return { directionId: 'mobile', subTrackId };
  }

  if (combined.includes('java') || combined.includes('spring')) {
    return { directionId: 'backend', subTrackId: 'java' };
  }

  if (combined.includes('go') || combined.includes('golang')) {
    return { directionId: 'backend', subTrackId: 'golang' };
  }

  if (combined.includes('node') || combined.includes('nest') || combined.includes('express')) {
    return { directionId: 'backend', subTrackId: 'nodejs' };
  }

  return { directionId: 'backend', subTrackId: 'python' };
}
```

```typescript
/**

export function saveVkGroupId(groupId: string): void {

  if (clean) {

  } else {
    localStorage.removeItem(VK_GROUP_ID_STORAGE_KEY);
  }
}

/**
 * Send real VK message via VK Bots API or fallback simulation
 */
export async function sendVkMessage(
  peerId: string | number,
  text: string,
  botToken?: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; messageId?: number }> {
  const token = botToken || getSavedVkToken();

  if (!token) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'VK Bot Token не указан. Введите ключ доступа сообщества во вкладке «Парсер & Боты», чтобы протестировать отправку.',
    };
  }

  const rawStr = String(peerId).trim().replace(/^vk_/i, '');
  const idMatch = rawStr.match(/(?:(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:m\.)?vk\.com\/(?:id)?)?(\d+)/i);
  const cleanPeerId = idMatch && idMatch[1] ? idMatch[1] : rawStr.replace(/^id/i, '');
  if (!cleanPeerId) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Укажите корректный Peer ID (числовой ID пользователя или беседы ВКонтакте).',
    };
  }

  // VK Keyboard for messages
  const keyboard = JSON.stringify({
    inline: true,
    buttons: [
      [
        {
          action: {
            type: 'open_app',
            app_id: Number(VK_APP_ID),
            label: '🚀 Запустить IT-Старт',
          },
        },
      ],
    ],
  });

  const formParams = new URLSearchParams();
  formParams.append('v', '5.199');
  formParams.append('access_token', token);
  formParams.append('peer_id', cleanPeerId);
  formParams.append('random_id', String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647)));
  formParams.append('message', text);
  formParams.append('keyboard', keyboard);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.vk.com/method/messages.send', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      },
      body: formParams.toString(),
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if (data.error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `VK API [${data.error.error_code}]: ${data.error.error_msg}`,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      messageId: typeof data.response === 'number' ? data.response : data.response?.[0]?.message_id || 1,
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    // In browser with CORS restrictions on direct api.vk.com, proxy through Render server
    try {
      const renderRes = await fetch('https://it-start-bot.onrender.com/notify', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          chatId: `vk_${cleanPeerId}`,
          text,
          platform: 'vk',
        }),
      });
      if (renderRes.ok) {
        const renderData = await renderRes.json();
        if (renderData.success) {
          return {
            success: true,
            messageId: renderData.messageId,
          };
        }
        return {
          success: false,
          error: renderData.error || 'Ошибка отправки через сервер уведомлений',
        };
      }
    } catch {}

    return {
      success: false,
      error: err.message || 'Сетевая ошибка при обращении к api.vk.com',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Auto-detect VK Peer ID from recent bot conversations on Render
 */
export async function autoDetectVkPeerId(): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  peerId?: string | number;
  firstName?: string;
  fullName?: string;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const serverUrl = 'https://it-start-bot.onrender.com';
    const res = await fetch(`${serverUrl}/vk/latest-user`);
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.ok && data.peerId) {
        saveVkPeerId(String(data.peerId));
        return {
          success: true,
          peerId: data.peerId,
          firstName: data.firstName,
          fullName: data.fullName,
        };
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  const saved = getSavedVkPeerId();
  if (saved) {
    return {
      success: true,
      peerId: saved,
      firstName: 'Пользователь VK',
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    error: 'Не удалось определить VK ID автоматически. Откройте диалог с сообществом ВКонтакте (vk.com/im?sel=-242573933), отправьте любое сообщение и повторите попытку!',
  };
}
```

```typescript
import officialVkBridge from '@vkontakte/vk-bridge';

export interface VkLaunchParams {
  vk_user_id?: number;
  vk_app_id?: number;
  vk_is_app_user?: number;
  vk_are_notifications_enabled?: number;
  vk_language?: string;
  vk_ref?: string;
  vk_access_token_settings?: string;
  vk_group_id?: number;
  vk_viewer_group_role?: string;
  vk_platform?:
    | 'mobile_web'
    | 'desktop_web'
    | 'mobile_android'
    | 'mobile_iphone'
    | 'mobile_ipad'
    | 'android'
    | 'iphone'
    | string;
  vk_is_favorite?: number;
  vk_ts?: number;
  sign?: string;
  [key: string]: string | number | undefined;
}

export interface VkUser {
  id: number;
  first_name?: string;
  last_name?: string;
  sex?: number;
  city?: { id: number; title: string };
  country?: { id: number; title: string };
  photo_100?: string;
  photo_200?: string;
  timezone?: number;
}

declare global {
  interface Window {
    vkBridge?: {
      send: (method: string, params?: Record<string, any>) => Promise<any>;
      subscribe: (fn: (event: { detail: { type: string; data: any } }) => void) => void;
      unsubscribe: (fn: (event: { detail: { type: string; data: any } }) => void) => void;
      isWebView?: () => boolean;
      supports?: (method: string) => boolean;
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Parse vk_* launch parameters from a query string or current window.location.search
 */
export function parseVkLaunchParams(searchString?: string): VkLaunchParams {
  let search =
    searchString !== undefined
      ? searchString
      : typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? window.location.search
      : '';

  // If search query is empty, check hash query (for SPA / GitHub Pages routing)
  if (!search && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hash.includes('vk_')) {
    const qIndex = window.location.hash.indexOf('?');
    if (qIndex !== -1) {
      search = window.location.hash.slice(qIndex);
    } else {
      search = window.location.hash.slice(1);
    }
  }

  if (!search) return {};

  let clean = search;
  const qIndex = clean.indexOf('?');
  if (qIndex !== -1) {
    clean = clean.slice(qIndex + 1);
  } else if (clean.startsWith('#')) {
    clean = clean.slice(1);
  }

  const params = new URLSearchParams(clean);
  const result: VkLaunchParams = {};

  params.forEach((value, key) => {
    if (key.startsWith('vk_') || key === 'sign') {
      const num = Number(value);
      (result as any)[key] = !isNaN(num) && value.trim() !== '' && !key.includes('language') && !key.includes('platform') && !key.includes('role')
        ? num
        : value;
    }
  });

  return result;
}

/**
 * Get active VK Bridge instance (window.vkBridge if defined, otherwise official @vkontakte/vk-bridge)
 */
export function getVkBridge() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).vkBridge) {
    return (window as any).vkBridge;
  }
  return officialVkBridge;
}

/**
 * Detect if the application is currently running inside VK Mini App
 */
export function isVkMiniApp(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;

  // 1. Check vk_* query parameters in URL (primary indicator of VK Mini App launch)
  const launchParams = parseVkLaunchParams();
  if (launchParams.vk_user_id || launchParams.vk_app_id || launchParams.vk_platform) {
    return true;
  }

  // 2. Check if running inside VK mobile WebView
  const bridge = getVkBridge();
  if (typeof bridge?.isWebView === 'function' && bridge.isWebView()) {
    return true;
  }

  // 3. Check if cached VK user exists
  if (cachedVkUser) {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Get active VK Launch Parameters
 */
export function getVkLaunchParams(): VkLaunchParams {
  return parseVkLaunchParams();
}

export interface VkViewSettings {
  statusBarStyle?: 'light' | 'dark';
  actionBarColor?: string;
  navigationBarColor?: string;
}

let cachedVkUser: VkUser | null = null;

export function getCachedVkUser(): VkUser | null {
  return cachedVkUser;
}

export function setCachedVkUser(user: VkUser | null): void {
  cachedVkUser = user;
}

/**
 * Configure VK Mini App View Settings (Status Bar and Action Bar colors)
 */
export async function setVkViewSettings(settings?: VkViewSettings): Promise<boolean> {
  const bridge = getVkBridge();
  if (!bridge || typeof bridge.send !== 'function') {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    await bridge.send('VKWebAppSetViewSettings', {
      status_bar_style: settings?.statusBarStyle || 'dark',
      action_bar_color: settings?.actionBarColor || '#ffffff',
      navigation_bar_color: settings?.navigationBarColor || '#ffffff',
    });
    return true;
  } catch {
    // Unsupported on some desktop/web contexts
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Initialize VK Bridge connection
 */
export async function initVkBridge(): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  user: VkUser | null;
  launchParams: VkLaunchParams;
}> {
  const launchParams = getVkLaunchParams();
  let user: VkUser | null = cachedVkUser;

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return { success: false, user: null, launchParams };
  }

  // 1. If vk_user_id is present in launch params, initialize minimal user fallback
  if (!user && launchParams.vk_user_id) {
    user = {
      id: launchParams.vk_user_id,
      first_name: 'Пользователь VK',
    };
  }

  // 2. Call VKWebAppInit & SetViewSettings if bridge is available and running inside VK
  const isInsideVk = isVkMiniApp();
  const bridge = getVkBridge();
  if (bridge && typeof bridge.send === 'function' && isInsideVk) {
    try {
      // Subscribe to VK Bridge events for dynamic safe-area insets
      if (typeof bridge.subscribe === 'function') {
        bridge.subscribe((event: any) => {
          if (event?.detail?.type === 'VKWebAppUpdateConfig') {
            const insets = event.detail.data?.insets;
            if (insets && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
              const root = document.documentElement;
              if (insets.top != null) root.style.setProperty('--vk-safe-area-top', `${insets.top}px`);
              if (insets.right != null) root.style.setProperty('--vk-safe-area-right', `${insets.right}px`);
              if (insets.bottom != null) root.style.setProperty('--vk-safe-area-bottom', `${insets.bottom}px`);
              if (insets.left != null) root.style.setProperty('--vk-safe-area-left', `${insets.left}px`);
            }
          }
        });
      }

      await bridge.send('VKWebAppInit');
      await setVkViewSettings({
        statusBarStyle: 'dark',
        actionBarColor: '#ffffff',
        navigationBarColor: '#ffffff',
      });

      try {
        const userInfo = await bridge.send('VKWebAppGetUserInfo');
        if (userInfo && userInfo.id) {
          user = {
            ...(user || {}),
            ...userInfo,
          };
        }
      } catch {
        // User info may require permissions; fallback to launchParams
      }

      cachedVkUser = user;
      return { success: true, user, launchParams };
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[VK Bridge] Ошибка вызова VKWebAppInit:', e);
    }
  }

  cachedVkUser = user;
  return { success: isVkMiniApp(), user, launchParams };
}

/**
 * Request native VK permission for bot community messages (VKWebAppAllowMessagesFromGroup)
 * and/or push notifications inside VK Mini App
 */
export async function requestVkNotificationsPermission(groupId: number = 242573933): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const bridge = getVkBridge();
  if (!bridge || typeof bridge.send !== 'function') {
    return { success: false, error: 'VK Bridge недоступен вне клиента ВКонтакте' };
  }

  try {
    const res = await bridge.send('VKWebAppAllowMessagesFromGroup', { group_id: groupId });
    if (res?.result) {
      return { success: true };
    }
  } catch (e: any) {
    // If user already gave permission or dismissed without fatal block
    const reason = e?.error_data?.error_reason || '';
    if (reason.includes('already') || e?.error_type === 'client_error') {
      return { success: true };
    }
    return { success: false, error: e?.error_data?.error_description || reason || e?.message || 'Разрешение не получено' };
  }

  return { success: true };
}

/**
 * Direct request for current VK User profile
 */
export async function getVkUserProfile(): Promise<VkUser | null> {
  if (cachedVkUser) return cachedVkUser;
  const res = await initVkBridge();
  return res.user;
}

export type VkHapticImpactStyle = 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy';
export type VkHapticNotificationType = 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

/**
 * Trigger haptic/taptic feedback in VK Mini App
 */
export function triggerVkHaptic(
  type: 'impact' | 'notification' | 'selection' = 'impact',
  styleOrResult?: VkHapticImpactStyle | VkHapticNotificationType | string
) {
  const bridge = getVkBridge();
  if (!bridge || typeof bridge.send !== 'function') return;

  try {
    if (type === 'notification') {
      const resType =
        styleOrResult === 'warning' || styleOrResult === 'error' ? styleOrResult : 'success';
      bridge.send('VKWebAppTapticNotificationOccurred', { result_type: resType }).catch(() => {});
    } else if (type === 'selection') {
      bridge.send('VKWebAppTapticSelectionChanged', {}).catch(() => {});
    } else {
      const style =
        styleOrResult === 'medium' || styleOrResult === 'heavy' ? styleOrResult : 'light';
      bridge.send('VKWebAppTapticImpactOccurred', { style }).catch(() => {});
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore haptic errors on unsupported platforms
  }
}
```
